main_content.text: About Afwan Tech and How We Compare With Top Digital Marketing Companies
A digital marketing and software team in Whitefield, Bengaluru that would rather show evidence than claim a rank.

Afwan Tech is a private digital marketing and software company with one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We build websites, apps and custom software, and we run SEO, paid ads and social media for businesses across India and abroad. This page explains what we are and are not, how we work, and how we compare with the top digital marketing companies and software companies you may be considering.

If you searched for top digital marketing companies or the best digital marketing agency, you probably want a shortlist you can trust. We will be honest: we do not appear on lists of India's largest firms, and we do not claim to be number one at anything. What we offer instead is a single team where developers and marketers work together, clear written plans, full ownership of everything we create for you and reports that show what your money produced. The rest of this page gives you the facts to decide whether that suits you.

items: One office in Whitefield, Bengaluru; no branch offices elsewhere
Website, app, custom software and e-commerce development
SEO, paid ads, social media and branding from the same team
Written scope and exact total before work starts
Your code, accounts, content and data always stay in your name

main_content.text: What We Are, and What We Are Not
Being clear about this saves everyone time. Here is an honest description of who we are.

rows: A focused team that builds and markets digital products

A network with branches in many cities or countries

main_content.text: What Does Afwan Tech Do?
We help businesses get found, chosen and served online. Most clients use more than one of our services, because a website, its marketing and the systems behind it work best when planned together.

rows: Business websites, custom web applications and portals, online stores, Android and iOS apps
Website, custom web, e-commerce and app pages
SEO, paid ads on Google, Bing, Meta and LinkedIn, social media management
SEO, PPC and social media pages
Brand identity, logos, marketing graphics, UI and UX design
Updates, fixes, monitoring, reporting and improvements after launch

main_content.text: Our Story

Note: This section tells the real story of Afwan Tech: when and where it started, who founded it, the legal entity name and registration details (such as CIN or GSTIN), and genuine milestones. It is written only from facts the business supplies and can prove (see Part 6). Figures such as client counts or years in business are published only when they can be verified.

What we can say now is how we choose to work: as one team in one office, with build and growth under the same roof, and with honesty about what we can and cannot do. That approach shapes everything else on this page.
Who Leads the Work?

Note: This section shows the real people behind Afwan Tech: name, role, a real photo, relevant experience and a link to a professional profile for each person. It is filled only with details the business supplies and confirms (see Part 6). No stock photos or invented profiles are used.

Every project is led by a named person who stays your main contact from the first call to handover. You will know who designs your screens, who writes your code, who runs your campaigns and who checks the work before it reaches you. If a team member changes during a project, we tell you in advance and hand over properly.
How Do We Work?
Our process is the same whether a project is a single landing page or a full platform. It is designed so you always know what is happening, what it costs and what you own.

items: Free audit or discovery call to understand your goals, customers and current situation.
Written proposal with scope, deliverables, timeline by stage and the exact total.
Access to your accounts through proper user roles, never shared passwords.
Work in short cycles, with something you can review at the end of each one.
Testing on real devices, data checks and approvals before anything goes live.
Launch with tracking in place, so results can be measured honestly.
Regular reports in plain language, with what worked, what did not and what comes next.
Full handover of code, files, accounts and documentation whenever you need it.

main_content.text: How Do We Communicate With Clients?
Good communication prevents most project problems. We agree the rhythm at the start and keep to it.

items: A named project lead who answers your questions and coordinates the team.
A shared project board or task list where you can see what is done, in progress and waiting for you.
Regular check-ins by video call, at a frequency that suits the project.
Written summaries after important calls, so decisions are not lost.
Monthly reports for ongoing services, in plain language with clear next steps.
WhatsApp or email for quick questions during agreed working hours, with urgent issues escalated as agreed.

main_content.text: What Happens in the First Month of Working Together?

The first month sets the tone for everything after it. For most projects, it looks like this. In the first week, we confirm goals, collect access to your accounts through proper user roles and agree how you would like to communicate. In the second week, we complete any audits, set up tracking and share a detailed plan for the work ahead. In weeks three and four, the first deliverables arrive: designs, a staging site, a campaign set-up or a content calendar, depending on the service. At the end of the month, we review progress together, adjust anything that is not working and confirm the plan for the next stage.
Our Principles
These principles guide every decision we make, from how we write proposals to how we report results.
Honesty Before Persuasion
We would rather lose a project than win it with a promise we cannot keep. We do not guarantee rankings, leads or app store approval, and we say so plainly when a service will not help you.
One Team, Fewer Handoffs
Developers, designers and marketers plan together. That means speed, tracking and search are built in from the start, and problems are fixed by the people who find them.
Your Business, Your Assets
Domains, hosting, code, ad accounts, analytics, social pages and content are registered to your business. We are added as users and can be removed at any time.
Evidence Over Opinion
We measure what matters to your business, such as enquiries, sales, time saved or errors reduced, and we show the source of every number we report.
Clear Costs
Every project has a written scope and exact total before work starts. Money paid to platforms, such as ad spend or hosting, is shown separately and paid directly by you where possible.
How Do We Compare With Top Digital Marketing Companies in India?

When people search for top digital marketing companies, top marketing agencies or top marketing companies in India, they usually find a mix of very different businesses. Comparing them only by size or fame can be misleading. This table shows the main types of provider and where a team like ours fits.

rows: Wide service range, big media budgets, many offices
Higher minimum budgets, junior staff on smaller accounts
May separate development and marketing into different teams
Developers and marketers in one team, direct access to the people doing the work
Smaller capacity than large firms; one office
Small and growing businesses that want build and growth together
Flexible, often cost-effective for single tasks

main_content.text: The best digital marketing agency for you is the one whose size, skills and way of working match your project, not necessarily the one at the top of a list. A small business can be a priority client for a focused team and a minor account for a large network.
What Do the Top Digital Marketing Companies Have in Common?
Whatever their size, the top digital marketing companies tend to share a few habits. These are worth looking for in any provider, including us:

items: They start with your business goals and customers, not with a package or a platform.
They measure what matters, such as enquiries, sales and cost per customer, and explain their numbers.
They are open about what they will not do, and they do not promise guaranteed rankings or leads.
They put strategy, creative and technical work in the hands of people who talk to each other.
They keep your accounts and data in your name and document their work.
They publish real case studies and let you speak to past clients.
They keep learning, because search engines, ad platforms and social networks change every year.

main_content.text: Size and fame are not on that list. Some of the top digital marketing companies in India are very large; others are small teams that do excellent work for a particular type of client. The habits above are what make the difference to your results.
A Step-by-Step Way to Shortlist From Lists of Top Digital Marketing Companies
Lists of top digital marketing companies can be a useful starting point if you treat them as a long list, not a final answer. This simple process turns any list into a confident decision.

items: Write down your goal, budget range and timeline before you look at any list.
Pick eight to ten names from different sources, not just one ranking.
Remove any provider that does not clearly offer the services you need.
Read two or three relevant case studies from each remaining provider and check that results have sources.
Shortlist three, and ask each for a short proposal or audit based on your actual situation.
Speak to one past client for each shortlisted provider.
Compare the proposals on scope, ownership terms, reporting and who will do the work, not only on price.
Choose the one whose plan you understand best and whose people you would be comfortable working with every week.

main_content.text: Following these steps usually takes two to three weeks and gives you far better evidence than any ranking of top digital marketing companies could on its own.
Large Agency or Focused Team: What Changes in Practice?
Many businesses compare a well-known name from lists of top digital marketing companies with a smaller, focused team. Both can do good work; the experience is different.

rows: Account managers, with specialists behind them
The people planning and doing the work
Often higher, to cover larger overheads
Scoped to the project, including smaller ones
Very broad, sometimes including offline media
Digital build and growth services only
Can be slower because of internal processes
Limited; we say so when a project is too large for us
Priority given to a small account
Usually high, because every client is significant

main_content.text: How Are "Top 10" Agency Lists Made?

Lists of the top 10 digital marketing companies in India, the top 10 digital marketing agencies in India or the top 5 digital marketing companies in India appear on many websites. Some are researched carefully; others are paid placements or simply copied from older lists. The same applies to searches like top 10 marketing company in India or top ten marketing company in India. Before trusting any ranking, check:

items: Who published the list, and do they disclose payments or sponsorships?
What criteria were used: revenue, client reviews, awards or simply who applied?
When was it last updated, and are the companies still operating as described?
Does the list explain what each company is good at, or only give a rank?
Can you find independent reviews or case studies for the agencies listed?

main_content.text: Under Indian consumer guidelines on misleading advertisements, notified in June 2022, claims about objectively verifiable facts should be capable of substantiation. A ranking that cannot explain itself is not much use to a buyer, whoever is on it.
India's Largest Software Companies, and Where We Fit

Many people also search for the largest software company in India or the top software companies in India. India's technology industry is very large: NASSCOM estimated in February 2026 that industry revenue would reach about USD 315 billion in FY26, with direct employment of around 59.5 lakh people. At the top, a handful of listed IT services firms dominate. By reported revenue for FY2024â€“25, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) was the largest, followed by Infosys, HCLTech and Wipro.

These firms, and others often named in lists of the top 5 software companies in India, the top 10 software companies in India, the top ten software companies in India or the top most software companies in India, serve mainly large enterprises with huge outsourcing and technology programmes. Afwan Tech is not one of them, and does not compete with them. A software companies list that puts global IT services giants next to small agencies compares very different businesses; the useful question is which kind of provider fits your project.
How Do You Choose the Best Software Development Company for Your Project?

Whether you are comparing the top software development companies or a few smaller teams, the best software development company for you is the one that fits your scope, budget and way of working. These questions help:

items: Have they built something similar, and can you speak to that client?
Will you work directly with the people writing the code?
Do they write a specification and give an exact total for each phase?
Will the code, database, cloud accounts and documentation be in your name?
How do they test, and how do they handle security?
What support do they offer after launch, and how fast do they respond to serious problems?

main_content.text: A large firm may suit a large programme with many teams. A focused team may suit a business that wants direct contact and one partner for both software and marketing.
How Do We Keep Learning?

Search engines, ad platforms, app stores and social networks change their rules every year. Staying current is part of the job, not an extra. We follow official sources, such as Google Search Central, Google Ads and Meta policy updates, Apple and Google Play developer requirements and Indian regulations that affect our clients. Before major changes reach client work, we test them on internal projects or small campaigns. When a change affects you, such as a new store requirement for your app or a policy change for your ads, we tell you in plain language and explain what we will do about it.
How Do We Use AI Tools?

Like many teams, we use AI tools where they genuinely help: drafting first versions, summarising research, checking code or speeding up repetitive tasks. Every output is reviewed, edited and fact-checked by a person before it reaches you or your customers. We do not mass-produce content or pages with AI, we do not put clients' confidential data into tools that are not approved for it, and we follow Google's guidance that what matters is helpful, accurate content made for people, however it is produced.
How Do We Handle Mistakes and Disagreements?

Every team makes mistakes sometimes. What matters is how they are handled. If we get something wrong, we tell you as soon as we know, explain what happened, fix it and share what we will change to prevent it happening again. If you disagree with a recommendation, we explain our reasoning and the data behind it, and then respect your decision as the owner of the business. If a project is no longer working for you, we hand over everything cleanly, without holding accounts, files or code back.
Why We Do Not Publish Big Claims

Many websites, including those of some top digital marketing companies, lead with very large numbers: total clients, revenue generated, countries served. We have chosen not to publish figures like these unless we can show exactly how they were calculated. It is easy to inflate totals, and harder for a buyer to check them. We would rather you judge us on specific case studies with sources, a conversation with the people who will do the work and a reference call with a past client. That is a slower way to build trust than a headline figure, but it is one you can rely on, and it is the standard we would expect from any of the top digital marketing companies you are comparing us with.
Where Do We Work?

We have one office, in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We do not have branch offices in other cities or countries. We work with clients across India and abroad through video calls, shared project boards, review links and regular written updates, and clients in Bengaluru can meet us in person by appointment.
Our website includes pages about the cities and regions we serve. Those pages describe how we work with businesses in those places remotely; they do not mean we have an office there.
Our Approach to Pricing and Value

We do not publish one price list for every situation, because two businesses asking for the same service rarely need the same work. Instead, every project starts with an audit or discovery call and a written proposal that lists the scope, deliverables, timeline by stage and the exact total. Costs paid to other providers, such as ad spend, hosting, app store accounts or paid plugins, are shown separately and paid directly by you wherever possible. If the scope changes during a project, the change and its effect on the total are agreed in writing before work continues. Our pricing page explains how our packages are structured.
What Makes a Good Working Relationship?

The projects that go best share a few features on both sides. On ours: clear plans, steady communication and honest reporting. On the client's side: one person who can make decisions, timely feedback and access to the information we need, such as product details, customer questions and sales results. When both sides keep to these, projects run on time and results are easier to measure. We discuss these expectations openly at the start, so nobody is surprised later.
Our Policies on Reviews, Claims and Data
Trust depends on what we will not do as much as what we will.

items: Reviews and testimonials: we never buy, write or edit reviews. India's IS 19000:2022 standard on online consumer reviews says purchased reviews must be labelled and that reviews written by people employed for that purpose should not be published; we simply do not publish any review that is not genuine.
Claims: every result we publish is backed by the client's data, with a source and time period, and published only with written permission.
Images: we use real photos of our work and our people, not stock images presented as clients or team members.
Data: we access client systems through proper user roles, keep personal data only as long as needed and follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, as it comes into force.
Advertising: we follow platform policies and Indian advertising rules, and we do not run ads for products the law prohibits.

main_content.text: Accessibility and Inclusion in Our Work

We want the websites, apps and content we create to work for as many people as possible. That means following the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 in design and development, writing in plain language, adding captions to videos and testing on the ordinary phones and networks many Indian users rely on. We also write in Hindi and other Indian languages where a client's audience prefers them. Accessibility is part of the standard work in every project, not an optional extra added at the end.
Who Do We Work Best With?
We do our best work for businesses that value direct contact and honest advice.

items: Small and growing businesses that need a website, marketing or both, and want one partner.
Startups building an app or web product that also needs to be marketed.
Service businesses such as clinics, consultancies, coaching centres and contractors that rely on steady enquiries.
Online stores that want their platform and marketing planned together.
Companies replacing spreadsheets with simple custom tools.

main_content.text: When We Are Not the Right Fit

items: You need TV, radio, print or outdoor advertising.
You need hundreds of people working on a programme at once.
You want guaranteed rankings or a fixed number of leads.
You want your accounts or code held by the agency.

main_content.text: In those cases, we will tell you honestly and, where we can, suggest the kind of provider that would suit you better.
Three Typical Situations Clients Come to Us In
These situations are illustrative, not case studies. Names and details are changed.
Situation 1: A Business Owner Tired of Juggling Vendors

A clinic owner (details changed) pays one freelancer for the website, another for Google Ads and a third for social media. Nobody owns the overall result. She wants one team that can plan the website, ads and social together and report on bookings, not clicks.
Situation 2: A Founder Comparing Large and Small Agencies

A startup founder (details changed) has quotes from a large agency and from smaller teams. The large agency has an impressive client list, but his project would be handled by a junior team. He wants to understand the trade-offs before choosing.
Situation 3: A Company Checking Whether We Are Real

A procurement team (details changed) needs to verify a vendor before signing: address, contact details, how the work is done and who owns the output. This page, our portfolio and a reference call are where that check starts.
Common Mistakes When Choosing an Agency
These mistakes lead to wasted budgets and frustrating projects.

items: Choosing an agency because it appears on a "top 10" list without checking how the list was made.
Judging by client logos rather than asking what was actually delivered.
Signing without a written scope, total and ownership terms.
Letting the agency register your domain, ad accounts or code in its own name.
Accepting guaranteed rankings or leads, which nobody can honestly promise.
Not speaking to a past client before signing.
Hiring separate vendors for build and marketing with nobody responsible for the whole.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Us Before You Decide
We encourage you to ask us these questions, and to ask any other provider the same.

items: Who exactly will work on my project, and can I speak to them before signing?
Can you show work similar to mine, and can I speak to that client?
What is included in the total, and what is paid directly to platforms?
Will every account, file and line of code be in my name?
How will you report results, and how often?
What happens if we stop working together?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Own Team

items: What problem are we solving, and how will we know it is solved?
Who will approve work on our side, and how quickly can they respond?
What budget range and timeline are realistic?
Do we need one partner for build and marketing, or separate specialists?

main_content.text: Special Cases
Some working arrangements need extra care. We treat these separately.
Confidential Projects
Many clients ask us to sign a non-disclosure agreement before sharing details. We do so on request, and we never mention a client publicly without written permission.
Projects That Change Direction

Sometimes a business changes direction mid-project: a new product, a new market or a new budget. When that happens, we pause, agree the new goals in writing, adjust the scope and total, and continue only when everyone is clear on the change.
Overseas Clients
For clients outside India, we agree working hours, communication channels and invoicing in advance, and we confirm any country-specific requirements with the client and their advisers.
Working Alongside Your Team or Other Agencies
If you already have developers, designers or another agency, we agree clear responsibilities in writing, so work is not duplicated and everyone knows who owns which result.
White-Label Work
We sometimes build for other agencies under their brand. That work is never shown in our portfolio, and we never contact their clients directly.
Our Commitments to Every Client
When you work with Afwan Tech, these commitments are part of every agreement:

items: A written scope and exact total before work starts.
A named person responsible for your project.
Access through proper user roles; everything you own stays in your name.
Honest reports, including what did not work.
No guaranteed rankings, no fake reviews, no bought links or followers.
A full handover whenever you ask for it.

bottom_content.text: About Afwan Tech: An Honest Alternative to Lists of Top Digital Marketing Companies

**Afwan Tech** is a private digital marketing and software company with one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We build websites, web applications, online stores and mobile apps, and we run SEO, paid ads, social media and branding for small and growing businesses across India and abroad. Developers, designers and marketers work as one team, so the people who plan your growth also understand the technology behind it.

Many people reach this page after searching for the top digital marketing companies or the best digital marketing agency. We understand why: choosing a partner is a big decision. We do not claim a rank, and we do not appear on lists of the largest firms. Whether you are reading about top marketing agencies, top marketing companies in India, a top 10 marketing company in India or a top ten marketing company in India, the most useful test is the same: real work you can check, references you can call and a written plan you understand.

The same applies to rankings such as the top 10 digital marketing companies in India, the top 10 digital marketing agencies in India or the top 5 digital marketing companies in India. Some lists are carefully researched; others are paid placements or copied from older articles. Check who published a list, what criteria were used and when it was updated, then verify each agency through case studies and conversations.

India's technology industry is very large, and its biggest firms are global IT services companies. By reported revenue for FY2024â€“25, Tata Consultancy Services was the largest software company in India, followed by Infosys, HCLTech and Wipro. Lists of the top software companies in India, the top 5 software companies in India, the top 10 software companies in India, the top ten software companies in India or the top most software companies in India usually feature these and similar enterprises. A software companies list that places them beside small agencies compares very different businesses serving very different needs.

If you are looking for the best software development company for a specific project, or comparing the top software development companies, focus on fit rather than fame. Ask who will write the code, whether you will own it, how the work will be tested and what support follows launch. A large firm suits large programmes; a focused team suits businesses that want direct contact and one partner for both software and marketing.

Our approach is simple. Every project starts with an audit or discovery call and a written proposal with the scope, timeline and exact total. Work happens in short cycles you can review, with a named project lead, a shared task board and reports in plain language. Domains, code, ad accounts, analytics and content stay in your name, and we hand everything over whenever you ask. We do not guarantee rankings or leads, we never buy or write reviews, and every result we publish is backed by the client's own data with written permission.

We follow platform policies and Indian rules that affect our clients, including consumer guidelines on misleading advertisements, standards for genuine online reviews and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We use AI tools only where they help, with a person reviewing every output, and we design for accessibility so the products we build work for as many people as possible.

We are not the right fit for everyone. If you need TV or print advertising, hundreds of people on one programme or guaranteed results, we will say so and suggest the kind of provider that would suit you better. If you want an honest team that builds and grows your digital presence together, we would be glad to talk.

Contact **Afwan Tech**, ITPL Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 79798 50684. Email: contactafwantech@gmail.com. Pricing for each project is shared after we review your requirements.

main_content.text: Android and iOS Apps People Keep Using, Built by a Mobile App Development Company
Flutter, React Native and native apps planned, built, launched and supported by one team in Bengaluru.

Mobile app development is the process of designing, building, testing and publishing apps for phones and tablets, then updating them after launch. A mobile app development company handles that work from idea to app store. Afwan Tech is a mobile app development company in Whitefield, Bengaluru that builds Android and iOS apps with Flutter, React Native or native code, along with the admin panels and APIs behind them.

A mobile product earns its place on a phone only if people open it again. That means it must solve one clear problem, load quickly on ordinary phones, work on patchy networks and feel familiar on both Android and iPhone. We plan the product around those needs, build it in short cycles you can test yourself, publish it to Google Play and the App Store under your own accounts, and stay available for updates as operating systems change.

main_content.text: What Do Our Mobile App Development Services Include?
Our mobile app development services cover the full journey, not just the screens. When you hire us as your mobile app development company, the project includes:

items: Discovery: users, goals, competitors, must-have features and what can wait for version two.
User journeys and wireframes for every key screen, then a clickable prototype.
Visual design that follows Android and iOS conventions so it feels natural on each.
Development for Android and iOS, with offline handling and push notifications where needed.
Back-end APIs, database and an admin panel to manage users, content, orders and reports.
Integrations: payments, maps and location, SMS and WhatsApp messages, analytics and crash reporting.
Testing on real low-, mid- and high-end phones, including slow networks.
Store listing preparation, privacy forms, submission and responses to reviewer questions.
Launch support, training for your team and a plan for the first updates.

main_content.text: App Development Services vs Application Development Services

People use these phrases in different ways. Our app development services usually mean mobile apps installed from Google Play or the App Store. Application development services is a wider term that also covers web applications used in a browser. We do both, and many projects need both: a mobile app for customers and a web dashboard for staff. Web platforms are handled by our custom web development team, working alongside the app team.
Website and App Development Together

Many businesses need website and app development at the same time: a website that explains the service and ranks on search, and a mobile product that existing customers use every week. Planning them together means one login system, one product catalogue, one set of APIs and consistent branding. It also avoids paying two vendors to build the same back end twice.
Native, Cross-Platform or Web App: Which Should You Build?
The right technology depends on what the product must do, how fast you need it, your budget and who will maintain it. We recommend an approach after discovery and explain the trade-offs in writing.

main_content.text: Cross-platform frameworks have matured a lot, and for most business apps they deliver a smooth experience at a lower total cost than two native apps. We do not claim they are identical to native in every case; when a feature needs native code, we write that part natively and connect it.
Flutter App Development Company

As a Flutter app development company, we use Flutter when you want a distinctive design that looks the same on Android and iPhone, smooth custom animations, or one team maintaining both platforms. Flutter also suits apps that may later run on tablets or the web from the same code.
React Native App Development Company

As a React Native app development company, we choose React Native when your product already has a React website, when your in-house team knows JavaScript, or when you want to reuse business logic across web and mobile. It renders real platform components, so lists, inputs and navigation feel native on each system.
Native App Development Services, iOS App Development and Android Apps

Our native app development services suit products that rely heavily on the camera, Bluetooth devices, sensors, background location, audio processing or platform features such as widgets. For iOS app development we use Swift and Apple's tools; for Android we use Kotlin. As an Android app development company, we also plan for the very wide range of Android devices in India, from budget phones with limited memory to flagship models, and our Android application development services include testing on older Android versions your customers still use.
Custom Mobile App Development vs App Builders

Builders and white-label templates can launch something basic quickly. They work for simple catalogues or content apps. Custom mobile app development makes sense when your workflow, pricing, logistics or user experience is what makes your business different, when you need to own the code, or when monthly builder fees and limits start to cost more than a build. We will tell you honestly if a builder is enough for your stage.

main_content.text: What Are the Google Play and App Store Requirements in 2026?
Store rules change every year, and missing one can block a launch or an update. These are some current requirements we plan for. We re-check the official pages before every submission.

rows: New apps and app updates must target Android 16 (API level 36) or higher
From 31 August 2026; developers can request an extension to 1 November 2026
New personal developer accounts must run a closed test with at least 12 testers opted in for 14 consecutive days before applying for production access
Applies to personal accounts created after 13 November 2023
Uploads to App Store Connect must be built with Xcode 26 or later, using the iOS 26 SDK or newer
Privacy disclosures: Google Play's Data safety form and Apple's App Privacy details must match what the app actually collects
Checked at review and when data use changes

main_content.text: No developer can guarantee that Apple or Google will approve a submission on the first try, because reviews depend on the stores' own policies and reviewers. What we can do is follow the published guidelines, prepare complete test accounts and notes for reviewers, and respond quickly to any questions.
Personal or Organisation Developer Account?

If you register the Google Play account as an organisation with proper business documents, the store listing shows your business name and the personal-account testing rule above does not cover it in the same way; Google's own verification steps still apply. We usually recommend organisation accounts for businesses, opened in your company's name, with us added as users.
Industry Apps We Build
Some app types come up again and again. Each has its own users, rules and integrations, so we plan them with care.
Food Delivery App Development Company

As a food delivery app development company, we build the three parts every delivery business needs: a customer app for browsing menus and ordering, a delivery-partner app for accepting and completing orders, and a restaurant or kitchen panel for managing menus and order status, all tied to an admin dashboard. Live tracking, slot-based delivery, ratings from real customers and payment integration are standard building blocks. Food businesses also need to show the food safety licence details required for their model, which your adviser should confirm.
Grocery Delivery App Development Company

Grocery apps add stock that changes by the hour, substitutions, weight-based pricing and delivery slots. As a grocery delivery app development company, we build store-level inventory, picker apps for staff, substitution approvals by the customer and slot management, connected to your billing or POS system where it offers an API.
Taxi Booking App Development Company

Ride apps need a rider app, a driver app and an operations dashboard working in real time. As a taxi booking app development company, we handle maps, live location, fare rules, trip states, driver onboarding documents, payments and safety features such as trip sharing and emergency contacts. Taxi app development in India also involves aggregator licensing and state transport rules, which must be confirmed with your legal adviser before launch.
Fintech App Development Companies and Regulated Apps

Payments, lending, insurance and investment apps are regulated. Among fintech app development companies, the important difference is how seriously security, consent and regulatory partnerships are treated. We build the app, onboarding flows and integrations, but the regulated activity itself must sit with a licensed entity such as a bank, NBFC or payment aggregator, and your compliance team must approve flows and disclosures.
Education App Development Company

As an education app development company, we build learning apps for coaching centres, schools, edtech startups and training teams: live and recorded classes, tests, progress tracking, fee payments and parent updates. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, processing a child's personal data needs verifiable consent from a parent or guardian, so we design sign-up and consent flows with that in mind and ask your legal adviser to confirm the details.

main_content.text: How Do We Keep Your App Secure and Private?
Phones get lost, networks are public and apps hold personal data, so security is part of the design.

items: Login with OTP, email or social sign-in, and optional biometric unlock using the phone's own secure features.

Only the device permissions the product truly needs, requested at the moment they are useful.
Payment card data handled only by approved payment gateways.
Privacy policy, Data safety and App Privacy disclosures that match what it actually does.

main_content.text: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 are coming into force in phases. We can build consent screens, data-deletion requests and access controls, but your legal adviser should confirm what your product must do.
Designing for Everyone: Accessibility and Inclusive Design

A mobile product should work for people with low vision, limited dexterity, hearing loss or little experience with smartphones. Inclusive design also helps everyone else, for example when someone is using a phone in bright sunlight or with one hand on a crowded bus. We follow the accessibility guidance built into Android and iOS and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines where they apply to mobile screens.

items: Text that respects the phone's font-size setting and still fits the layout.
Colour contrast that stays readable outdoors, and meaning never shown by colour alone.
Touch targets large enough for thumbs, with enough space between them.
Labels for screen readers such as TalkBack and VoiceOver on every button and image that matters.
Captions or transcripts for video lessons and spoken content.
Simple language, clear error messages and the option to go back without losing work.

main_content.text: We check these points during design reviews and test key journeys with screen readers before release. Building them in from the start costs far less than fixing them after launch, and it widens the audience your product can reach.
Launch Is the Start: Updates, OS Changes and Support

Android and iOS release major versions every year, devices change and stores update their rules, as the 2026 requirements above show. Software that is never updated slowly breaks or gets removed from the stores. Our optional support covers bug fixes, updates for new OS versions and store requirements, dependency and security updates, crash monitoring, performance checks and small improvements. New features are planned and quoted as phases. You can end support at any time and receive a full handover.
What Does the Total Cost Depend On?
We do not publish fixed prices on this page, because two projects that sound similar can need very different work. The total is made up of a few clear parts:

items: Number of apps (for example customer, partner and admin) and user roles.
Number of screens and the complexity of features such as live tracking, chat or offline mode.
Technology approach: cross-platform, native or a mix.
Back end and admin panel scope, and integrations with other systems.
Design depth, from a clean standard interface to a fully custom design system.
Third-party costs paid directly to providers: developer accounts, maps, SMS, cloud hosting, video or payment services.
Testing range, security reviews and ongoing support after launch.

main_content.text: Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements, usually phase by phase so you can launch the most valuable part first.
Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Restaurant Group Paying High Commissions

A restaurant group (details changed) gets most delivery orders through large aggregators and wants a direct channel for loyal customers. We would build a branded ordering app with saved addresses, repeat orders, loyalty points and a kitchen display panel, connected to their own delivery staff and payment gateway, while they continue on aggregators for new customers.
Situation 2: A Coaching Institute Moving Classes Online

A coaching institute (details changed) runs classes through video links shared on WhatsApp and tracks fees in spreadsheets. We would build a learning app with recorded lectures, live-class links, tests, progress reports and fee reminders, with parent accounts and consent flows for students under 18.
Situation 3: A Field-Service Company Still Using Paper Job Cards

An appliance-repair company (details changed) sends technicians out with paper job cards, so updates and payments are slow. We would build a technician app that works offline, captures photos and customer signatures, collects payments by UPI and syncs to a web dashboard for the office team.
Common Mistakes in App Projects
These mistakes cost money, months and user trust. Most are easy to avoid when planned early.

items: Trying to launch every feature at once instead of a focused first version.
Building an app when a mobile-friendly website would serve customers better.
Registering developer accounts in the agency's or a freelancer's name.
Testing only on the latest flagship phones, not on the budget devices many users own.
Ignoring the admin panel, so staff cannot manage the app without a developer.
Asking for every phone permission on first launch, which makes users uninstall.
Forgetting store privacy forms and policies until the week of submission.
Leaving no budget for updates after launch, so the app falls behind OS and store requirements.
Copying a large competitor's app feature for feature without a clear reason for users to switch.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Before You Hire App Developers
Ask any team of app developers these questions, including us. Clear written answers are a good sign.

items: Which technology do you recommend for my app, and why that one?
Will the code, designs and both store accounts be in my company's name?
Which devices and OS versions will you test on?
What does the admin panel include, and can my team use it without help?
How will you handle store submission, testing tracks and reviewer questions?
How do you protect user data on the phone and on the server?
What support do you offer after launch, and how quickly do you fix crashes?
Can you show apps you have built, with the owner's permission, and can I speak to them?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Apple, Google and Your Other Providers
Some answers sit with your providers. Before the project starts, check:

items: Apple and Google: which account type suits your business, what documents are needed and how long verification takes.
Payment gateway: whether its mobile SDK supports your app type and which payment methods are enabled.
Maps and messaging providers: pricing per request or message, and limits at your expected volume.
Any regulator or licensing body for your industry: what must be in place before an app goes public.

main_content.text: What This Service Does Not Do
To keep expectations clear, our app development service does not:

items: Guarantee approval by Apple or Google, a store ranking or a number of downloads.
Publish apps under our own developer accounts on your behalf.
Copy another company's app design, brand or content.
Use cracked or unlicensed libraries, tools or assets.
Run regulated activities such as lending, payments or insurance; those require licensed partners.
Collect data the app does not need, or hide data use from users and the stores.
Give legal advice; we build to the requirements your advisers confirm.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need an App
We would rather save you money than build something nobody installs.

items: If customers interact with you only a few times a year, a fast mobile website is usually better.
If you are still testing demand, a progressive web app or a no-code prototype can prove the idea first.
If an existing app or marketplace already serves your customers well, improve your listing there first.
If there is no budget to maintain the app after launch, wait until there is.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some apps need extra planning. We treat these separately.
Offline-First Apps

Field staff, drivers and rural users often lose network. We store data safely on the device, let users keep working and sync changes automatically when the connection returns, with clear signs of what has and has not synced.
Budget Phones and Small Storage
Many users in India have phones with limited memory and storage. We keep app size down, compress images, avoid heavy background tasks and test on low-end devices before release.
Indian Languages
Apps in Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and other languages need careful fonts, layouts that handle longer words and content managed from the admin panel without app updates.
Taking Over an Existing App

If your previous developer has left, we audit the code, accounts, build set-up and store listings before suggesting whether to continue, refactor or rebuild. We also check that the store accounts and signing keys are under your control.
Apps for Children
Apps aimed at children face stricter store policies and data rules. We plan age-appropriate design, parental consent and minimal data collection from the first workshop.
How Do You Choose the Right Mobile App Development Company?

Choosing a mobile app development company is a long-term decision, because the team that builds version one usually supports it for years. Compare providers on how they think, not just on how their portfolio looks.

rows: They ask about users, goals and what to leave out of version one
They quote a price from a one-line brief
They explain why Flutter, React Native or native fits your case
They push one framework for every client
Code, designs and store accounts are in your company's name
They publish under their own developer accounts
Real devices, slow networks and older OS versions
Only a demo on the latest flagship phone
Admin panel and APIs are part of the plan
Clear support plan for OS and store-rule changes
No mention of what happens after release

main_content.text: A mobile app development company that also builds websites and runs marketing can plan the whole customer journey, from the search result to the first order inside the product, which is often where the real gains are.
What Makes Users Keep Using an App?
Downloads are easy to buy and easy to lose. Retention, meaning how many people come back next week and next month, decides whether a mobile product succeeds. We design for it from the start:

items: A first session that delivers value within a minute, without long sign-up forms.
Sign-in by OTP or a familiar account, and the option to explore before registering where it makes sense.
Notifications that are useful, timed well and easy to control.
Fast screens on ordinary phones, with clear loading states instead of blank pages.
Saved preferences, addresses and history, so repeat tasks take seconds.
In-product feedback and genuine store reviews requested at the right moment, never bought.

main_content.text: We track these signals with analytics agreed in the plan, so you and your mobile app development company look at the same numbers when deciding what to improve next.
About "Top App Development Companies in India" Lists

You will find many lists of top app development companies in India. Treat them with care: some are paid placements, and none can tell you whether a team suits your app and budget. Instead, install apps the team has actually built, read their genuine store reviews, speak to the owners and judge how clearly the team explains its plan, ownership terms and support. We do not claim a rank; we invite you to check our work.
Why Choose Afwan Tech as Your Mobile App Development Company?
We would rather earn trust through how we work than through badges. Here is what you can expect when we are your mobile app development company:

items: Honest advice on whether you need an app at all, and which technology fits.
A written scope and exact total for each phase.
Test builds you can install every sprint, not just progress reports.
Mobile front end, admin panel, APIs and integrations from one team.
Code, designs and store accounts in your company's name.
Store rules and privacy forms planned from the start, not the last week.
Support for OS updates and new features after launch, or a clean handover.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Mobile App Development Company
What does a mobile app development company do?
A mobile app development company plans, designs, builds, tests and publishes apps for Android and iOS, and maintains them after launch. It also builds the back end and admin panel the app depends on.
Do you build apps for both Android and iOS?
Yes. We build for both platforms, usually from one Flutter or React Native codebase, or as separate native apps when the features require it.
Should I choose Flutter, React Native or native development?
It depends on your design, features, team and budget. Flutter suits custom designs, React Native suits teams with web skills, and native suits heavy device features; we recommend one after discovery.
What is included in your mobile app development services?
Discovery, UX design, app development, back end and admin panel, integrations, testing, store submission and training. Support after launch is optional.
Do you offer custom mobile app development or templates?
We focus on custom mobile app development built around your workflow. If a builder or template would genuinely serve you better at your stage, we will say so.
Can you build a food delivery or grocery delivery app?
Yes. We build customer, delivery-partner and store or restaurant apps with an admin dashboard, live tracking, slots, payments and inventory or POS integration where available.
Do you build taxi booking apps?

Yes. Our taxi app development covers rider and driver apps, an operations dashboard, maps, fares, payments and safety features. Licensing and transport rules must be confirmed with your legal adviser.
Do you build fintech apps?

Yes, for the app, onboarding and integrations. The regulated activity must sit with a licensed partner such as a bank, NBFC or payment aggregator, and your compliance team approves flows and disclosures.
Do you build education apps for students?
Yes. We build learning apps with classes, tests, progress tracking and fee payments, and design consent flows for children's data as required under India's data protection law.
Will my app be approved by Apple and Google?
No developer can guarantee approval. We follow the published store guidelines, complete privacy disclosures, provide reviewer notes and test accounts, and respond quickly to reviewer questions.
What are the current Google Play and App Store requirements?

Google Play requires new apps and updates to target Android 16 (API level 36) from 31 August 2026, and Apple requires uploads built with Xcode 26 or later from 28 April 2026. We re-check rules before every submission.
Will I own the app and the store accounts?
Yes. The source code, designs and both developer accounts are registered in your company's name, and we are added as users.
Can you also build a website for the app?
Yes. We often handle website and app development together, sharing one back end, login system and brand, so customers get a consistent experience.
How long does it take to build an app?
It depends on the number of apps, roles, features, integrations and store review rules. We give an indicative schedule by stage in the written proposal.
How much does mobile app development cost?
The total depends on apps, features, technology, back end, design, integrations and third-party fees. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.
Do you work with clients outside Bengaluru?
Yes. We have one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and work with clients across India and abroad through video calls, project boards and test builds you can install.
Related Services
Explore our custom web development, website development, e-commerce development, SEO services and pricing pages for more detail.

bottom_content.text: Android and iOS Apps From a Mobile App Development Company You Can Check

**Afwan Tech** is a mobile app development company in Whitefield, Bengaluru that plans, designs, builds, publishes and supports products for Android phones, iPhones and tablets. Our mobile app development services cover discovery, user journeys, prototypes, interface design, the back end and admin panel, integrations, testing on real devices, store submission and training. We register the code, designs and both developer accounts in your company's name from the first day.

Choosing the right technology comes first. As a Flutter app development company, we use Flutter when you want a distinctive design that looks the same everywhere. As a React Native app development company, we use React Native when your team already works with JavaScript or React. When features such as Bluetooth hardware, background location or demanding graphics require it, our native app development services use Kotlin for Android and Swift for iOS app development. As an Android app development company, we also test on the budget and mid-range phones many Indian users own, and our Android application development services include support for older operating system versions still in use.

Not every idea needs fully custom work. Builders and templates can suit simple catalogues or early tests; custom mobile app development makes sense when your workflow, pricing or logistics is what sets you apart. Many clients also ask for website and app development together, so one back end, one login system and one brand serve customers on every screen. When the scope includes browser-based dashboards or portals, our web team connects the phone experience to those tools, and for cross-platform builds the same logic is shared across Android and iOS wherever it safely can be.

Some product types come up again and again. As a food delivery app development company, we build customer, delivery-partner and restaurant tools tied to one dashboard. As a grocery delivery app development company, we add live stock, substitutions, picker tools and delivery slots. As a taxi booking app development company, we build rider and driver products with maps, fares, trip states and safety features; taxi app development also involves licensing and state transport rules that your adviser must confirm. Among fintech app development companies, we focus on security, consent and working with licensed partners, and as an education app development company we design parental consent for students under 18 in line with India's data protection law.

Store rules change every year. From 31 August 2026, Google Play requires new submissions and updates to target Android 16 (API level 36), and since 28 April 2026 Apple requires uploads built with Xcode 26 or later. New personal Google Play developer accounts must also complete a closed test with at least 12 testers over 14 consecutive days before going live. We plan these requirements from the start, prepare privacy disclosures that match real data use, and support updates after launch so the product keeps working as Android and iOS change.

You will see many lists of top app development companies in India. We do not claim a rank. Install products a team has actually built, read their genuine store reviews, speak to the owners and ask how clearly the team explains ownership, testing and support. If you want to hire app developers for a defined task rather than a full project, we take on focused work too.

How a project runs is simple. A discovery workshop sets the goals and the first version's scope. A written proposal gives the technology recommendation, phases and the exact total for phase one. A clickable prototype is tested with a few real users before the build begins. Every two weeks you receive a test build to install on your own phone. Before release we test on real devices and slow networks, run security checks, prepare store listings and submit under your accounts. After launch, we watch crash reports and reviews and plan the next improvements with you.

Pricing for each phase is shared after we review your requirements. We do not guarantee store approval, rankings or download numbers, because those depend on Apple, Google and the market; we do guarantee honest advice, clean code you own and clear communication at every step.

We have one office and work with clients across India and abroad through video calls, project boards and test builds. Contact **Afwan Tech**, ITPL Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 79798 50684. Email: contactafwantech@gmail.com.

main_content.text: Custom Web Apps, Portals and Business Software From a Software Development Company
Software shaped around how your business actually works, built and supported by one team in Bengaluru.

Custom web development means building a web application around your own processes, instead of bending your business to fit off-the-shelf software. A software development company plans, codes, tests and supports that application. Afwan Tech is a software development company in Whitefield, Bengaluru that builds custom web apps, portals, dashboards, CRM and ERP modules, and the integrations that connect them.

Most businesses reach us at the same point: spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and three or four subscription tools are holding the operation together, and the gaps are costing time and money. We map how work really flows, decide what should be automated, and build software your team will actually use. You own the code, the data and the documentation.

items: Custom web applications, client and vendor portals, dashboards and internal tools
Custom CRM, ERP modules, booking engines and workflow automation
API integrations with payment gateways, accounting, messaging and existing systems
Front-end and back-end development, testing, deployment and support in one team
One office in Whitefield, Bengaluru; we work with clients across India and abroad remotely

main_content.text: What Is Custom Web Development, and How Is It Different From a Website?

A website mainly publishes information: services, contact details, articles. A web application does work. People log in, enter data, follow steps, get results and see reports. Custom web development is the craft of building those applications for one organisation's needs, rather than adapting a general product made for thousands of customers.

rows: Company site with services and a contact form
A web design and development team
Lets users log in and complete tasks
Gives a group of users their own secure area
Customer, dealer, vendor or student portal
General tool rented by many businesses

main_content.text: If what you need is a marketing website, our website development team is the right fit. If people need to log in and get work done, you are in the territory of custom software.
Build, Buy or Extend: When Is Custom Software the Right Choice?

Custom software is not always the answer, and an honest software development company should say so. Many good products already exist. The question is whether one of them fits closely enough, and what it will cost to live with the gaps.

rows: A standard tool covers most of your needs and your process is common
Per-user fees grow; you change your process to fit the tool
Your current tool is mostly right but lacks a few features or connections
Some products limit APIs or customisation
Your process is a competitive advantage, or no product fits without heavy workarounds
Higher upfront effort; you need a support plan
Off-the-shelf for standard needs, custom for the parts that make you different

main_content.text: A Quick Decision Checklist

items: Do your teams copy the same data between two or more tools every day?
Do you pay for many user licences mainly so people can view a few reports?
Is a key step in your process handled in spreadsheets because no tool supports it?
Would a mistake in that manual step cost you a customer, money or compliance trouble?
Is the way you work part of why customers choose you?

main_content.text: If you answered yes to two or more, custom software deserves a serious look. If not, improving or connecting your current tools may be enough, and we will tell you that.
What Do Our Software Development Services Include?

Our software development services cover the full life of an application, from the first workshop to support after launch. You can hire us for the whole journey or for one part, such as specification, front-end work or an integration.

items: Discovery workshops to map users, roles, steps, data and pain points.
A written specification with user stories, screens and acceptance criteria.
UX and interface design, tested with real users where possible.
Front-end and back-end development in short, reviewable cycles.
Database design, data migration and reporting.
Integrations with payment gateways, accounting, messaging, maps and other systems.
Automated and manual testing, security checks and performance testing.
Deployment, monitoring, backups and documentation.
Training, handover and optional ongoing support.

main_content.text: Web Application Development Services

Our web application development services turn a business process into software people can use from any browser. Typical examples include quoting and order tools, approval workflows, inventory and dispatch systems, booking engines and reporting dashboards. We sometimes describe these as web app development services because many clients search that way; the meaning is the same.
Web Portal Development Company for Customers, Partners and Teams

As a web portal development company, we build secure areas where a specific group of people can log in and see only what belongs to them: customers checking orders and invoices, dealers placing orders, vendors uploading documents, students accessing courses, or employees submitting requests. Role-based access, audit trails and clear dashboards are standard.
Custom CRM Development

Many businesses outgrow generic CRMs, or pay for features they never use while missing the one they need. As a CRM development company, we build lean CRMs around your sales stages, lead sources and follow-up rules, connected to your website forms, phone system, WhatsApp and email where the providers allow it.
Custom ERP Development

Custom ERP development rarely means replacing everything at once. We usually build the modules that standard ERPs handle badly for your business, such as production planning, job costing, field service or multi-location stock, and connect them to the accounting or ERP system you already use.
Back-End Development and Integrations

As a backend development company, we build the databases, APIs, background jobs and integrations that make applications reliable. We document every API so your team or other vendors can build on it later.
Front End Development Services

Our front end development services focus on interfaces that are fast, accessible and easy to learn. We build reusable components, keep forms short, show clear error messages and test on the devices your users actually have.
Features We Often Build Into a Custom Web Application
Every custom web application is different, but some building blocks come up again and again. Planning them early saves time later:

items: Secure login with roles, permissions and optional two-step verification.
Dashboards with filters, charts and exports to Excel or PDF.
Multi-step forms with validation, file uploads and saved drafts.
Approval workflows with notifications by email, SMS or WhatsApp.
Search across records, with saved views for different teams.
Audit trails that show who changed what, and when.
Scheduled reports and automatic reminders.
An admin area to manage users, settings and master data without a developer.

main_content.text: API Integration: How We Connect Your Systems

Most of the value in custom software comes from connecting it to the tools you already rely on. API integration means two systems exchange data automatically through a documented interface, so nobody has to re-type information. As a full stack team, we commonly connect applications to payment gateways, accounting software, email and SMS services, WhatsApp Business messaging, maps and location services, e-signature tools and existing ERPs or CRMs.

Before we promise an integration, we check four things: whether the other system offers an API, what it costs to use, what limits apply to requests and data, and whether a sandbox is available for testing. When no API exists, we look at safer alternatives such as scheduled file exports and imports. Every integration we build includes error handling and alerts, so a failed sync is noticed and fixed instead of silently losing data.
Which Technology Stack Do We Use?
We choose the stack after discovery, based on what the application must do, who will maintain it and where it will run. We do not force one framework on every project.

rows: Large ecosystem, reusable components, good performance
Mature, well-documented, many developers available for future hiring
MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), MEAN (with Angular)
One language across the stack; suits fast-moving products
Matched to data shape, reporting needs and scale
AWS, DigitalOcean or your preferred cloud, with Docker
Portable deployments in accounts you own
Automated tests, code review, CI/CD pipelines

main_content.text: React Development Company

React is our default for complex interfaces such as dashboards, data tables and multi-step forms. As a React development company, we build component libraries that keep screens consistent and make new features faster to add.
Laravel Development Company

For PHP projects, Laravel gives us a clean structure, built-in security features and a large community. Working as a Laravel development company suits businesses that already run PHP systems or have PHP developers in-house.
MERN Stack Development Services and MEAN Stack Developers

Our MERN stack development services suit products where speed of change matters and the data model is flexible. If your existing team or system uses Angular, a MEAN stack developer from our team can work within that set-up instead of forcing a rewrite.
Industry Solutions We Build

Every industry has its own workflows, rules and integrations. These are areas where custom software often pays off. Specific integrations depend on each provider's approval and API access, which we confirm before quoting.

rows: Booking engines, itinerary builders, agent portals, B2B rate management
Payment gateways, supplier APIs where access is granted, email and WhatsApp

Student portals, course management, admissions, fee tracking
Job cards, production planning, quality checks, stock
Client portals, document collection, time and billing
Messaging, payment; clinical data only with your compliance team's approval

main_content.text: Travel Software Development Company Projects

As a travel software development company, we build booking and quoting tools for agencies, tour operators and travel startups. Supplier and global distribution system connections need commercial agreements and certification from those providers, so we plan them with you from the start rather than promising them on day one.
Enterprise Software Development Company Work

For larger organisations, we work as an enterprise software development company on defined workstreams: a new internal platform, a module that sits beside an existing ERP, or a modern front end for a legacy system. We follow your security reviews, access rules and release processes. The same applies when we act as an enterprise app development company for internal web apps used by many departments.
How Does Our Custom Software Development Process Work?
We work in short cycles so you see progress early and can change direction before it becomes expensive.

items: Discovery workshop with the people who will use and approve the software.
Written specification: users, roles, screens, data, integrations and acceptance criteria.
Proposal with scope, phases, team and the exact total for the first phase.
Clickable prototype of key screens, tested with a few real users.
Development in two-week sprints, each ending with a demo on a test server.
Testing: automated tests, manual checks, security review and load testing where needed.
Data migration, training and launch, often to a small group first.
Support, monitoring and a plan for the next set of features.

main_content.text: Indicative Timeline by Stage

Note: these stages are indicative only. Real timelines depend on the number of roles, screens and integrations, data migration, third-party approvals and how quickly decisions are made. We confirm a schedule for each phase in writing.

header: What decides how long it takes
rows: Number of user types and processes; availability of decision-makers
Number of key journeys; rounds of feedback
Scope, integrations, complexity of business rules
Number of roles and edge cases; load expected
