main_content.text: How Do We Make Interfaces Accessible?

Accessible interfaces work for more people, including those with low vision, colour blindness, limited dexterity or temporary difficulties such as a cracked screen or bright sunlight. We follow WCAG 2.2, which became a W3C Recommendation on 6 October 2023 and added nine new success criteria. In our UI work that means:

items: Text and interface colours with enough contrast, and meaning never shown by colour alone.
Visible focus states for keyboard users and clear labels on every form field.
Tap and click targets large enough to hit easily, with space between them.
Layouts that still work when users enlarge text.
Error messages that explain what went wrong and how to fix it.
Motion that can be reduced for people sensitive to animation.

main_content.text: We check designs during reviews and again in the built product with developers, but we do not issue legal accessibility certificates.
What Does the Total Cost Depend On?
We do not publish fixed fees on this page, because branding and interface projects vary widely. The total depends on:

items: Scope: branding only, interfaces only or both.
Number of logo concepts, revision rounds and brand applications.
Number of screens, user types and states in an interface.
Research and testing: interviews, prototype tests and number of participants.
Design system depth and documentation.
Print or packaging items and file formats needed.
Third-party costs, such as licensed fonts, stock images or photography, paid directly or passed through at cost with your approval.

main_content.text: Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements, in writing, before work starts.
Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Startup With an App and No Brand

A two-founder health-booking startup (details changed) has a working app built with default colours and a placeholder logo. Investors and users find it hard to trust. We would run a short brand discovery, create a logo and palette that work on small app icons, update the app's UI with a component library and give the founders social and pitch-deck templates in the same style.
Situation 2: A Dashboard Staff Avoid Using

A logistics company (details changed) built an internal dashboard that staff find confusing, so they keep using spreadsheets. We would interview the people who use it daily, map their main tasks, redesign the navigation and key screens, test a prototype with a few staff members and hand our developers or theirs a clear specification.
Situation 3: A Family Business Refreshing a Decades-Old Identity

A family-run sweets brand (details changed) has a logo that looks dated and prints badly on new packaging. We would keep the recognisable elements customers love, modernise the lettering and colours, create a packaging system for different product lines and prepare print-ready files with physical proofs approved before production.
Common Mistakes in Branding and Interface Projects
These mistakes waste time and money, and some are hard to undo.

items: Choosing a logo by committee vote instead of against agreed goals and audience.
Skipping a trademark search, then having to rebrand after launch.
Accepting only flat image files, with no editable source files or written ownership.
Designing app screens without the developers who will build them.
Testing designs only with the internal team instead of real customers or users.
Ignoring accessibility, which excludes users and causes rework later.
Using unlicensed fonts, images or icons that create legal risk.
Creating a beautiful identity with no guidelines, so it is applied inconsistently.
Redesigning a working interface for looks alone, confusing existing users.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Before You Hire a Branding or UI UX Agency
Ask any provider these questions, including us. Clear written answers are a good sign.

items: How do you research our customers or users before designing?
How many concepts and revision rounds are included?
Will you test prototypes with real users, and how?
Which files will we receive, in which formats, and will they be editable?
Will copyright in the final work be assigned to us in writing, worldwide and without a time limit?
Are all fonts, images and icons properly licensed for our use?
How do you work with developers so the build matches the design?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Team, Developers and Printers
Some answers sit with other people. Before starting, check:

items: Your team: who has the final say, and what does success look like six months after launch?
Your developers: which framework and component library are used, and what limits should the design respect?
Your printer or packaging supplier: what file formats, colour modes and bleed sizes do they need?
Your trademark attorney: can the proposed name and logo be registered in your classes?

main_content.text: What This Service Does Not Do
To keep expectations clear, our branding and UI UX service does not:

items: Copy another company's logo, interface or brand style.
Use pirated software, fonts, images or icons.
Provide legal advice or file trademark applications; we work alongside your attorney.
Guarantee that a design will increase sales by a set amount.
Hold back source files or keep ownership of your final work.
Issue legal accessibility certificates, although we design and check for accessibility.
Print or manufacture materials ourselves; we prepare files for your printer.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need Us
We would rather tell you honestly when a full branding or UI UX project is not the right spend.

items: If you are still validating whether customers want your product, a simple, clean starter identity may be enough for now.
If your interface works well and users are happy, small targeted improvements beat a full redesign.
If you only need a one-off flyer or social post, a single graphics task is better value than a brand project.
If you have an in-house designer, a review or design-system workshop may be all you need.
If your business name may change soon, wait before investing in a full identity.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some projects need extra planning. We treat these separately.
Rebranding an Established Business

Changing a known brand carries risk: customers, staff and partners have expectations. We plan a phased rollout, keep recognisable elements where possible and prepare a checklist of every place the old brand appears, from signage to email signatures.
Multilingual and Indian-Script Branding

Brands used in Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or other scripts need lettering that works in each script, not just a translated name. We design logo lockups and typography pairings for each language you need.
Regulated Products and Packaging

Food, health, cosmetics and other regulated products have mandatory label information. We design around the content your compliance team provides and leave the required text and sizes to their approval.
Interfaces for Low-Literacy or First-Time Users
Some products serve people who are new to smartphones or prefer icons and voice. We use simple language, recognisable icons, larger targets and test with representative users.
Taking Over Someone Else's Design Files
If a previous designer has left, we review what files exist, rebuild missing source files where needed and organise everything into a usable library before new work starts.
Graphic Design Business or In-House Designer: Which Fits You?
You can work with a graphic design business like ours, hire a freelancer or employ an in-house designer. Each suits a different stage.

rows: You need branding, UX research, UI and development to work together
Make sure one named person leads your project
You need a defined piece, such as a logo or a set of templates
Availability, file handover and ownership terms
You need daily design support for marketing or product
Salary, tools and access to specialist skills such as UX research

main_content.text: Many companies combine these: an in-house designer handles everyday graphics, while a specialist team creates the brand system or the product interface.
Why Choose Afwan Tech for UI UX Design Services?
We would rather earn trust through how we work than through badges. Here is what you can expect from our UI UX design services and branding work:

items: Research and testing before polish.
Designers and developers working together, so designs are buildable.
Accessibility built in, following WCAG 2.2.
Licensed fonts, images and icons only.
Editable source files and written assignment of ownership.
Honest advice, including when a smaller fix beats a full redesign.
One team for branding, interfaces, websites, apps and marketing.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Our UI UX Design Services
What are UI UX design services?
UI UX design services plan how a website, app or software looks and how easy it is to use. They include research, journeys, wireframes, prototypes, screen layouts and design systems.
What is the difference between UI and UX?
UX is about how easily people can complete tasks; UI is about how each screen looks and behaves. Good products need both working together.
Do you also offer branding?
Yes. We create logos, colour palettes, typography, brand voice, guidelines and starter assets, and we can carry the identity into websites, apps and marketing.
What is included in your graphic design services list?
Social and ad creative, presentations, brochures, catalogues, packaging and label layouts, signage files, infographics and report layouts, each available alone or in a brand project.
Do you test designs with real users?
Yes, where the project allows. We test clickable prototypes with a small number of real users to find problems before development begins.
Will I own the final designs?
Yes. Copyright in the final approved work is assigned to you in writing, worldwide and without a time limit, and we hand over editable source files.
Why does the assignment need to be in writing?
Under India's Copyright Act, an assignment of copyright must be in writing, and missing details on duration or territory are presumed to limit it, so a clear written assignment protects you.
Can you help register my logo as a trademark?
We prepare the artwork, but a trademark attorney should run searches and file the application with India's Trade Marks Registry.
Do you design interfaces that developers can build?
Yes. Our developers review designs from the wireframe stage, and we provide components, states and specifications so the build matches the design.
Can your team also build the website or app?
Yes. Our UI UX design and development services cover both, or we hand clean specifications to your own developers.
Do you follow accessibility guidelines?
Yes. We design to WCAG 2.2 for contrast, focus, labels, text size and tap targets, and check again in the built product.
Do you use licensed fonts and images?
Always. Fonts, images and icons are licensed for your use, and any paid licences are agreed with you before purchase.
How many logo concepts and revisions are included?
The number is set in the written proposal based on scope, so you know exactly what to expect before work starts.
How long does a branding or UI UX project take?
It depends on scope, number of screens or assets, research and feedback speed. We give an indicative schedule by stage in the proposal.
How much do your UI UX and branding services cost?
The total depends on scope, concepts, screens, research, design system depth, print items and licences. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.
Do you work with clients outside Bengaluru?
Yes. We have one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and work with clients across India and abroad through video calls and shared design files.

bottom_content.text: Branding, Graphics and UI UX Design Services From One Team

**Afwan Tech** offers branding, graphic work and UI UX design services from one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, for businesses across India and abroad. We start with your customers and goals, test ideas with real people where possible, and hand over editable source files with ownership assigned to you in writing. Because our developers work in the same team, the interfaces we draw are realistic to build and fast to load.

Our UX design services cover research interviews, user journeys, sitemaps, wireframes, clickable prototypes and usability tests. Our UI design services turn approved structure into finished screens with every state a developer needs, and for growing products we create a design system so new screens stay consistent. When you need both planning and code, our UI UX design and development services and UI UX development services carry the work from first sketch to a working website, app or dashboard. Smaller needs, such as a UX audit of an existing product, are available as focused UI UX services too.

As a branding provider, we create logos, colour palettes, typography, brand voice and practical guidelines, then apply them to business cards, presentations, social templates and packaging. Planning branding and web design together means a new identity and a new website launch with one consistent look. As a branding and digital marketing agency, we can also carry the identity into ad creative, social posts and email.

Our graphic design services list covers social and ad creative, pitch decks, brochures, catalogues, packaging and label layouts, signage files and infographics, each available on its own or as part of a brand project. We provide graphic design services in India and abroad through video calls and shared files with comments, and clients in Bengaluru can meet us by appointment. Choosing a graphic design business, a freelancer or an in-house designer depends on how much you need and how often; we explain the trade-offs honestly.

Ownership matters. Under India's Copyright Act, 1957, an assignment of copyright must be in writing and should state duration and territory, or it is presumed to last five years and cover India only. That is why our agreements assign final, approved work to you in writing, worldwide and without a time limit. For trademark protection, a trademark attorney should search and file your logo with India's Trade Marks Registry; we prepare the artwork they need.

Accessibility is built in, following WCAG 2.2 for contrast, labels, focus states, text size and tap targets. We use only licensed fonts, images and icons, never copy other brands' work, and never hold back your files.

Every brand identity project tests logo design concepts on real applications, from app icons to shop signs, and every interface project measures user experience against goals agreed before work starts, such as task completion, enquiry conversion or fewer support questions. That way decisions rest on evidence, not only on taste.

How a project runs is simple: a discovery call, a written proposal with concepts, revision rounds and the exact total, research, concepts, refinement, testing, final files and a handover session. Pricing for each project is shared after we review your requirements.

A digital marketing company is a business that helps other businesses get found and chosen online through search engine optimisation (SEO), paid ads, social media, content and the website or app those channels lead to. Afwan Tech is a digital marketing company and software company in Whitefield, Bengaluru, so the people who build your site also market it.

That matters for anyone choosing a digital marketing company, because most growth problems sit between two teams: the developer who built the site and the agency that later tries to rank it. We remove that gap. You get one plan, one point of contact and one set of reports, whether you need a new website, a mobile app, an online store, search visibility or a steady flow of enquiries.

main_content.text: What Is a Digital Marketing Company, and What Does It Actually Do?

A digital marketing company plans and runs the online activity that brings customers to a business. In practice that means four jobs: making sure your website or app works well, making it visible on search engines and AI answers, putting paid ads in front of the right people, and turning visitors into enquiries or sales. Good marketing companies measure each of those jobs separately, so you can see which one is paying for itself.

The term is broad, and buyers often meet three overlapping labels. A "digital agency" usually leans towards design and development. An "internet marketing firm" or online marketing company leans towards traffic and leads. A software company builds products and custom systems. Afwan Tech sits across all three because we found that clients kept paying one vendor to build and another to fix what was built.
Digital Marketing Company vs Digital Agency vs Software Company

rows: Often depends on someone else to change the website
May hand over a site that is hard to rank or slow
Rarely plans how the product will be found or sold
Fixes are made by the same team that plans them
We do not run offline media such as TV, print or outdoor

main_content.text: If you only need one of these, a specialist may suit you better, and we say so in the section on when you do not need us.
Our Digital Marketing Services List: What Afwan Tech Does

Here is our full digital marketing services list, along with the build services that support it. Together they form the digital marketing solutions most businesses need, and you can hire us for one part or all of them. Each line links to its own detailed page, so you can go deeper on the part that matters to you.

rows: Technical fixes, on-page content, local SEO, Google Business Profile, AI-search readiness
Businesses that want steady enquiries without paying per click
Google Ads, Meta ads, LinkedIn ads, landing pages and conversion tracking
Launches, seasonal offers and fast lead flow

Brands that sell through trust, visuals and repeat buyers

New brands and products that need a clear look

main_content.text: Online Marketing Services

Our online marketing services cover the channels where buyers search, compare and decide. SEO builds lasting visibility on Google, Bing and AI answer engines. Paid search and social ads create demand quickly while SEO matures. Social media keeps your brand in front of people who are not ready to buy yet. Content such as guides, FAQs and comparison pages gives search engines and AI tools something worth citing. Conversion work, including forms, calls-to-action and WhatsApp buttons, makes sure that traffic turns into conversations.
Website, App and Software Development

We are also a software company, which means we write and maintain the code behind your growth. We build business websites, custom web applications, online stores and mobile apps, and we keep them fast, secure and easy to update. Because our developers sit with our SEO and ads specialists, page speed, structured data, tracking and clean URLs are planned before the first line of code, not patched in later.
Design, Branding and User Experience

A campaign only works if the page it leads to is clear. Our designers create brand identities, landing pages and app interfaces that make the next step obvious. We test layouts on real phones, because most of your visitors will arrive on one.
Why Does It Help to Have Build and Growth in One Team?

Most businesses hire one vendor to build a website and a second one to market it. The two rarely talk. When rankings fall, the marketing team blames the code; when leads are poor, the developers blame the ads. You pay both while the problem stays where it is.
As a digital marketing company with in-house developers, we avoid that handoff. Here is what changes in practice:

items: Speed and Core Web Vitals are designed in from the start, not fixed after launch.
Tracking for calls, forms and WhatsApp clicks is set up before campaigns go live.
Structured data, internal links and page templates are built for search from day one.
Landing pages for ads can be created in days by the same people who run the ads.
When Google or Meta changes something, one team decides what to change and does it.

main_content.text: This is also why we call ourselves a full service marketing agency only in a narrow sense: we cover the digital channels and the technology behind them, not TV, radio, print or outdoor advertising.
How Does Our Process Work?

Every engagement follows the same seven stages, whether you hire us for one service or several. The order matters: we never start spending your ad budget before tracking works, and we never write content before we know which page should own which search term.

items: Free audit. We review your website, search visibility, Google Business Profile, ads (if any) and how enquiries reach you.
Discovery call. We learn what you sell, who buys it, what a good lead looks like and what you have tried before.
Written plan and scope. You receive a plan with priorities, deliverables, owners and the exact total for the agreed scope.
Foundation work. Tracking, technical fixes, speed improvements and any new pages or builds come first.
Launch. Campaigns, content and new features go live in a planned order, not all at once.
Measure and adjust. We review results against the goals agreed in the plan and change what is not working.
Report and review. You get regular reports in plain language and a scheduled call to decide the next priorities.

main_content.text: Which Option Fits You: Agency, Specialist, Consultant or In-House?
There is no single right answer. The table below compares the four usual routes so you can choose honestly, even if the answer is not us.

rows: Full service marketing agency (like Afwan Tech)
You need several channels and the website or app behind them to work together
Make sure one named person owns your account and reports to you
You only need SEO or only need paid search, and your site is already in good shape
Changes to the website may still need a separate developer
You have an in-house team and need strategy, audits or training
One person has limited hours for hands-on work
Marketing is central to your business and you can hire and manage specialists
Salaries, tools and training add up; skills can be narrow

main_content.text: Agency or Digital Marketing Consultant in India?

Some businesses search for a digital marketing consultant in India because they want advice rather than a full team. We offer that too: a paid audit or a short advisory engagement where our specialists review your plan and train your staff, and your team does the work. If you already have developers and marketers, this is often the most cost-effective route.
How Should You Measure a Digital Marketing Company's Results?

A digital marketing company should be judged on business outcomes, not activity. Posts published, keywords tracked and impressions earned are useful signs of work, but they do not pay salaries. Before we start, we agree on the numbers that matter for your business and show them in every report.

rows: Organic enquiries, calls and sales from search
Clicks and impressions in Search Console, pages indexed, keyword positions
Cost per lead or cost per sale
Click-through rate, conversion rate, quality of leads reported by your sales team
Enquiries and sales from social channels
Reach, saves, shares, profile visits, message replies
Core Web Vitals, bounce on key pages, form errors, crash reports for apps
Google Business Profile views, review count and rating trend

main_content.text: We set targets only after the audit, because a fair target depends on your starting point, your market and your budget. If a number moves the wrong way, the report says so plainly and explains what we will change.
Why "More Traffic" Is Not the Goal

Traffic that never converts costs money. A good set of digital marketing solutions balances three things: reaching people who are likely to buy, giving them a page that answers their question, and making the next step easy. When one of those is weak, adding more of the other two rarely helps. This is the main reason we look at your website, your ads and your enquiry handling together before recommending any spend.
What You Should See in Every Report

items: The goals agreed in the plan and how each one moved since the last report.
What we did during the period, in plain language.
What did not work, and what we will change.
Any costs paid directly to platforms such as Google or Meta, shown separately from our fees.
The priorities we suggest for the next period, for you to approve.

main_content.text: Digital Marketing Services for Small Business, Startups and Growing Companies
Different stages of a business need different things. We adjust the scope to the stage you are at instead of selling the same package to everyone.
Marketing Services for Small Business

Local shops, clinics, coaching centres, service providers and traders usually need three things: a fast mobile website, a complete Google Business Profile and a simple way for customers to call or message. Our digital marketing services for small business start there. We fix the basics, set up local SEO and review management practices, and add paid ads only when the foundation can turn clicks into enquiries. We keep reporting short and focused on calls, messages and bookings, not jargon.
Digital Marketing Agency for Startups

Startups need learning before scale. As a digital marketing agency for startups, we help you test positioning, build a landing page or minimum viable product, run small paid experiments and set up analytics that tell you which channel brings paying users. When you find what works, we help you scale it, and because we also build apps and web platforms, your product and your marketing grow together.
Established Companies and Overseas Clients

For larger businesses we take on defined workstreams: a website rebuild, a technical SEO programme, a new app or a performance ads account. We also work with clients outside India over video calls and shared project tools. We are not a global marketing agency with offices in many countries; we are one Bengaluru team that is used to working across time zones and documenting everything clearly.
What Does the Total Cost Depend On?
We do not publish fixed fees on this page because two businesses asking for "SEO" or "a website" rarely need the same work. The total for any project is made up of a few clear parts:

items: Scope of work: number of pages, features, keywords, channels or content pieces.
Starting point: a site that needs repairs or migration takes more work than a clean one.
Competition: crowded markets need more content, links and testing to gain visibility.
Ad spend: money paid to Google, Meta or LinkedIn for ads is separate from our management work and goes to those platforms.
Third-party costs: domain, hosting, paid plugins, app store accounts or software licences, where needed.
Speed: tighter deadlines may need more people on the project at once.

main_content.text: Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements, in writing, before any work starts. For an overview of how we package ongoing work, see our pricing page.
Three Typical Situations We Help With
The situations below are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Clinic That Is Invisible on Maps

Dr. Mehra (name changed) runs a dental clinic. Patients who already know her are loyal, but new patients searching nearby rarely find her. Her website is slow on phones and her Google Business Profile has an old phone number. We would correct her business details everywhere, speed up the site, add clear service pages and set up a simple process for asking happy patients for reviews, without writing or buying any. Success here is measured in calls and booked appointments.
Situation 2: A Startup With an App and No Users

A two-founder startup (details changed) has built a booking app but cannot afford large ad budgets. We would review the app's onboarding, build a focused landing page, set up analytics and run small, controlled ad tests to find which message and audience bring sign-ups that stay. Only after the numbers make sense would we suggest scaling spend.
Situation 3: A Manufacturer With a Website From Years Ago

A family-run manufacturing business (details changed) gets most orders through dealers and wants direct enquiries from buyers in other states. Their website has no product pages and no enquiry form. We would rebuild the site with clear product categories, technical specifications and request-a-quote forms, then use SEO and targeted search ads to reach buyers searching for those products.
Common Mistakes Businesses Make When Hiring Marketing Companies
We see the same avoidable problems again and again. Checking these before you sign with any digital marketing company or freelancer will save money and months.

items: Choosing a vendor because they promised a guaranteed first-page ranking. Google itself warns that no one can guarantee a #1 ranking.
Letting the agency own your domain, website code, Google Ads or Meta Business accounts.
Starting ads before call and form tracking works, so nobody knows which ads produce leads.
Paying for hundreds of near-identical city pages that add little value and can break search engine spam rules.
Judging success by impressions or follower counts instead of enquiries, sales and cost per lead.
Redesigning a website without redirecting old URLs, losing years of search visibility overnight.
Hiring separate vendors for the website and the marketing with nobody responsible for the whole result.
Buying reviews or publishing invented testimonials, which damages trust and can lead to penalties.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Any Online Marketing Company Before You Sign

Whether you are comparing online marketing companies, software companies in India or freelancers, these questions show quickly who knows the work. Ask them of us too; a good digital marketing company will welcome every one of them.

items: Do you follow Google Search Essentials and the platform rules for Google Ads and Meta ads?
Who exactly will work on my account, and who is my single point of contact?
What will you do in the first 90 days, and what will you need from my team?
How will you measure success, and which numbers will appear in my reports?
Will I own the domain, website code, ad accounts and analytics from day one?
What happens to my accounts and data if we stop working together?
Can you show work you have done, with the client's permission, and can I speak to a past client?
How do you build links, and do you ever buy them?
What is included in the total, and what costs are paid directly to Google, Meta or other platforms?

main_content.text: What We Do Not Do
Being clear about limits is part of being trustworthy. A digital marketing company that will do anything for a quick result is a risk to your brand. As a matter of policy, Afwan Tech does not:

items: Guarantee a #1 or first-page ranking on Google or any other search engine.
Write fake reviews, buy reviews or publish testimonials that are not real.
Buy links, use private blog networks or join link schemes.
Build thin doorway pages that exist only to catch city searches.
Claim to be a Google, Meta or government partner unless the badge is real and verifiable.
Act as your legal or tax adviser. We can implement consent banners and privacy notices, but your lawyer should approve the wording.
Run offline media such as TV, radio, newspapers or hoardings.
Keep your accounts or code hostage. Everything we create for you is handed over.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need Us
We would rather tell you now than take on work that will not pay off for you.

items: If you have only just registered a business and do not yet know what you sell or to whom, start with conversations with customers, not an agency.
If your website gets enquiries you cannot handle, fix your sales and delivery capacity first; more traffic will not help.
If you need a single landing page for a one-day event, a simple website builder may be enough.
If you already have a strong in-house team and only need occasional advice, a short consulting engagement is better value than a monthly retainer.
If you only need offline advertising, a traditional advertising or media agency will serve you better.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some projects need extra care. These are the ones we plan for separately.
Rescuing a Site That Lost Rankings

If your traffic dropped suddenly, we first check whether it matches a known Google core or spam update, a technical change on your site (such as a migration or a blocked page) or a manual action shown in Search Console. The fix depends on the cause, so we diagnose before we change anything.
Website Migrations and Redesigns

Moving to a new platform or domain is the most common way businesses lose search traffic. We map every old URL to a new one, set up 301 redirects, keep page titles and content that already rank, and monitor Search Console closely after launch.
Businesses Serving Many Cities

If you serve many towns from one office, we create location content only where you have something genuinely local to say, such as real service areas, local projects or local regulations. Google's spam policies treat thin, near-duplicate city pages built only to rank as doorway abuse, and we do not build them.
JavaScript-Heavy Websites and AI Crawlers

Sites built with modern JavaScript frameworks can look complete to users but nearly empty to some crawlers. We use server-side rendering or static generation so that search engines and AI tools can read your key content without running scripts.
Regulated Industries

Healthcare, finance, education and legal businesses face extra advertising rules on Google and Meta, and sometimes from Indian regulators. We follow platform policies and ask you to confirm any claims with your compliance or legal team before ads or pages go live.
How Do Search Engines and AI Search Work Today?

Search has changed a lot in the last two years, so here is the short version of what Google itself says. Google's AI features, AI Overviews and AI Mode, show links to websites alongside AI-written answers, and Google states that no special optimisation or special structured data is needed to appear in them. A page must simply be indexed and eligible to show a snippet, and normal SEO best practices still apply. Google also updated its spam policies in May 2026 to state that they apply to all of Search, including AI answers.
For you, that means the basics matter more than tricks: clear pages that answer real questions, a fast and accessible website, accurate business information and genuine reputation signals.
Core Web Vitals Thresholds We Build To

rows: How quickly the main content appears
How quickly the page responds to taps and clicks
How much the layout jumps while loading

main_content.text: INP replaced First Input Delay as a Core Web Vital in March 2024. We check these numbers using real-user data in Search Console and PageSpeed Insights, not only lab tests.
How Do We Handle Your Data, Access and Confidentiality?
You will share sensitive things with us: logins, sales figures, customer lists and plans. We treat them carefully.

items: We ask for access through each platform's own user roles (for example, adding us to Google Analytics or Meta Business Manager) instead of asking for your passwords.
You remain the owner of every account; we are added as users and can be removed at any time.
We sign a non-disclosure agreement on request before you share confidential material.
Customer data is used only for the work you have approved.

India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 (notified in November 2025) are coming into force in phases. We can set up consent notices and form wording on your website, but please have your legal adviser confirm what your business must do.

main_content.text: Your Pre-Project Checklist
Have these ready before your first call and the audit will be faster and more useful:

items: Your website address and access to the hosting or website admin, if you have one.
Access to Google Search Console, Google Analytics and Google Business Profile (or tell us if they do not exist yet).
Access to any Google Ads, Meta or LinkedIn ad accounts.
A list of your main products or services, ranked by importance to your business.
The areas you serve and the customers you want more of.
Three competitors you lose business to.
Your goal for the next six to twelve months, such as more calls, more online sales or app installs.
Your brand files: logo, colours, fonts and photos you own.
Any deadlines, such as a launch date or seasonal peak.

Afwan Tech has one office, in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We do not have branch offices in other cities. We work with clients across India and abroad through video calls, shared project boards and WhatsApp, and we can meet in person in Bengaluru by appointment.

India has thousands of marketing companies and software companies, from large listed firms to one-person studios. We do not claim to be the biggest. We aim to be the team that answers clearly, builds properly and shows you what your money produced.

items: One team for code and growth, so problems are fixed rather than passed between vendors.
A written plan and an exact total before work starts.
Honest advice, including telling you when a service will not help.
Reports that track enquiries, sales and cost per lead, not vanity numbers.
Full ownership of your code, domain, accounts and data.
Search work that follows Google's published guidelines, so your visibility is built to last.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Digital Marketing Company
What does a digital marketing company do?

A digital marketing company helps businesses get found and chosen online. It plans and runs SEO, paid ads, social media and content, and improves the website or app those channels lead to, then measures which activity brings enquiries and sales.
Is Afwan Tech a digital marketing company or a software company?

Both. We are a digital marketing company with in-house developers, so we build websites, web apps, online stores and mobile apps, and we also run the SEO, ads and social media that bring people to them.
What is included in your digital marketing services?

Our digital marketing services include SEO, local SEO, Google and Meta ads, social media management, content and conversion improvements. We also offer website, e-commerce, custom software and mobile app development, and branding and UI/UX design.
Is Afwan Tech the no 1 marketing company in India?

No, and we would be wary of anyone who says they are. No independent body ranks a single no 1 marketing company in India; what matters is whether a provider fits your goals, shows real work and reports honestly.
Do you work as a full service marketing agency?
Yes, for digital channels. We cover strategy, websites and apps, SEO, paid ads, social media and design. We do not handle offline media such as TV, radio, print or outdoor advertising.
Do you offer digital marketing services for small business owners?
Yes. For small businesses we usually start with a fast mobile website, a complete Google Business Profile and local SEO, then add ads once the basics turn visitors into calls and messages.
Are you a good digital marketing agency for startups?

We work well with startups that want to test and learn before they scale. We can build your landing page, app or web product, set up analytics and run small, controlled campaigns to find what brings paying users.
Can you work as a digital marketing consultant in India instead of a full agency?
Yes. If you have your own team, we offer audits, strategy sessions and training while your staff carry out the work.
Do you work with clients outside India?
Yes, remotely. We are one Bengaluru team, not a global marketing agency with offices abroad, and we work with overseas clients through video calls and shared project tools.
How long does SEO take to show results?

SEO is gradual and usually takes months rather than weeks. The time depends on your site's condition, competition and how much content we can publish; we give you a realistic estimate after the audit.
Do you guarantee first-page rankings on Google?
No. Google itself says no one can guarantee a #1 ranking. We commit to clear work, honest reporting and following Google's guidelines.
How much do your services cost?
The total depends on scope, your starting point, competition and any ad spend paid to platforms. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.
Will I own my website, ad accounts and data?
Yes. Your domain, website code, ad accounts, analytics and content belong to you, and we hand everything over if we stop working together.
Do you help with AI search such as Google AI Overviews?
Yes. Google says normal SEO best practices apply to its AI features, so we focus on clear, well-structured pages, accurate business details, fast loading and content that answers real questions.
Do you have offices in other cities?
No. We have one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and we serve clients in other cities and countries remotely.
How do I start working with your team?
Call or WhatsApp 79798 50684, email contactafwantech@gmail.com or request a free audit through our contact page. We will review your site and reply with first recommendations.

bottom_content.text: Afwan Tech: A Digital Marketing Company That Also Builds Your Software

**Afwan Tech** is a digital marketing company and software company based in Whitefield, Bengaluru. We help businesses grow online by building the website, web app, online store or mobile app they need, and then bringing the right visitors to it through SEO, paid ads, social media and content. Because both jobs sit with one team, there is no gap between the people who write the code and the people who are responsible for results.

Our digital marketing services cover search engine optimisation, local SEO and Google Business Profile, Google and Meta advertising, social media management, content writing and conversion improvements. On the technology side, we design and develop business websites, custom web platforms, e-commerce stores and Android and iOS apps, along with branding and UI/UX design. If you want the complete digital marketing services list, our services page describes each one in detail, and you can hire us for a single service or combine several into one plan.

Many business owners compare marketing companies, online marketing companies and software companies in India before they decide. Some want a full service marketing agency that handles everything digital; others prefer a specialist search marketing agency, a digital agency for design, or an internet marketing firm focused only on leads. We explain these options honestly on this page and tell you which one fits your situation, even when it is not us. If you only need advice, we can also work as a digital marketing consultant in India for your in-house team.

We offer digital marketing services for small business owners such as clinics, shops, coaching centres, manufacturers and local service providers, with a focus on calls, messages and bookings rather than vanity numbers. Our marketing services for small business usually start with a fast mobile website, accurate business listings and local search visibility. We also work as a digital marketing agency for startups that need to test ideas, launch an app or landing page and learn which channel brings paying users before spending more.

Our online marketing services follow Google's published guidelines. We do not promise guaranteed rankings, we do not buy links or reviews, and we do not build thin pages for every city. People sometimes search for the no 1 marketing company in India; we do not claim that title, because no independent ranking decides it. What we do promise is a written plan, an exact total before work starts, honest reports and full ownership of your accounts, code and data. A good marketing company should be easy to check, and we invite you to check us.

How we work is simple. Every project starts with a free audit of your current website, search visibility, ads and the way enquiries reach you. We then share a written plan with clear priorities, named owners and an exact total. Foundation work comes first: tracking for calls, forms and WhatsApp clicks, technical fixes, page speed and any new pages or features. Only when that foundation is ready do we launch campaigns or publish content, so every rupee spent can be traced to a result. After launch, we review the numbers regularly, explain what worked and what did not, and agree the next steps with you.

This approach suits businesses that are tired of paying one vendor for website development and another to fix what was built. Our developers and growth specialists plan together, so page templates, structured data, internal links and Core Web Vitals are handled before launch rather than patched later. When Google, Meta or another platform changes its rules, the same team decides what to change and makes the change. For you, that means fewer handoffs, faster fixes and a clearer link between the work you pay for and the lead or sale it produces.

We are one team in one office, not a global marketing agency with branches abroad, yet we work with clients across India and in other countries through video calls and shared project tools. Whether you need a complete set of digital marketing solutions or a single fix, the first step is the same: a free audit of your website, search presence and enquiry flow.

Contact **Afwan Tech**, ITPL Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 79798 50684. Email: contactafwantech@gmail.com. Pricing for each project is shared after we review your requirements.

main_content.text: Our Work, Real Case Studies and a Downloadable Digital Marketing Portfolio PDF
Websites, apps, campaigns and brands we have built, shown with client permission and numbers you can check.

A digital marketing agency portfolio is a collection of real projects that shows what an agency did, for whom and what changed as a result. This page is Afwan Tech's portfolio. Every case study follows the same structure: the starting point, the solution, the work we did, results measured from the client's own data and the client's permission to publish. You can also request our digital marketing portfolio PDF to read offline or share with your team.

We hold our case studies to a simple rule: if we cannot show where a number came from, it does not appear. That means you will not find invented revenue figures, stock-photo testimonials or logos of companies we have not worked with. Some of our work is covered by confidentiality agreements, so it appears in anonymised form or not at all. What is here is meant to help you judge how we think, how we work and whether we are a good fit for your project.

items: Case studies across websites, apps, custom software, e-commerce, SEO, paid ads, social media and branding
Results shown with their source, time period and starting point
Client names, logos and quotes used only with written permission
A downloadable digital marketing portfolio PDF, available on request
References from past clients available for serious enquiries

main_content.text: Key Facts About This Portfolio

rows: Selected projects across web and app development, custom software, e-commerce, SEO, paid ads, social media and branding
Numbers come from the client's own analytics, ad accounts, Search Console, store or CRM data, with the time period stated
Every named client has approved the case study in writing; others are anonymised
Real quotes from real clients, never written by us, never paid for
Screenshots and photos of the actual work, not stock images
A digital marketing portfolio PDF with the same case studies, sent on request
Contact with past clients arranged for serious enquiries, with their agreement
A private company with one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru

main_content.text: How to Read Our Case Studies
Every case study on this page, and in our digital marketing portfolio PDF, uses the same layout. That makes it easy to compare projects and to see exactly what we were responsible for.

rows: Who the client is (or an anonymised description), their sector and size
The situation before we started, with baseline numbers where available
What the client wanted to achieve, in their words
The approach we chose and why, including what we decided not to do
The specific deliverables: pages built, campaigns run, features shipped
How long the work took, from start to the results reported
Measured outcomes, with the data source and time period stated
What worked, what did not and what we would do differently
A quote from the client, published with permission

main_content.text: Where a section does not apply, for example when a business has no reliable baseline data, we say so instead of leaving a gap. We include the "what we learned" section on purpose. Real projects rarely go perfectly, and an honest account of what fell short is often more useful to a future client than a list of wins.
Marketing Case Studies With Solutions, Organised by Service

Many people looking for marketing case studies with solutions want to see the problem and the fix side by side, not just a headline number. Our case studies are grouped by the service involved, and each one names the measures that matter for that kind of work.

rows: Slow, outdated or hard-to-edit site that does not bring enquiries
Page speed and Core Web Vitals, enquiry conversion, editing time for the client's team
Manual processes in spreadsheets and chat groups
Time saved per task, errors reduced, adoption by staff
Store that is slow, hard to manage or losing sales at checkout
Conversion rate, checkout completion, average order value, page speed
App idea or existing app with low usage
Active users, retention, crash-free sessions, store ratings from real users
Organic clicks and impressions, enquiries from organic search, indexed pages
High cost per lead or unclear return
Cost per lead, lead quality, cost per sale, return on ad spend
Inconsistent posting, little engagement, no enquiries
Engagement quality, profile actions, enquiries and sales from social
Task completion, user feedback, consistency across channels

main_content.text: What Our Work Looks Like, Service by Service
Beyond headline results, it helps to know what we actually deliver in each type of project. This is what you will see documented in the full write-ups.
Websites

Website projects show the sitemap and content plan, key page designs on mobile and desktop, the platform chosen and why, speed and Core Web Vitals before and after, redirect plans for redesigns, and how the owner's team now edits pages. Where enquiries are tracked, we show how form, call and WhatsApp conversions changed after launch.
Custom Software and Portals

For web applications and portals, we show the process before and after, the main screens with sensitive data hidden, the integrations built and how many people use the tool. The most meaningful results here are often time saved, fewer errors and staff who stopped using spreadsheets, rather than traffic.
Online Stores

Store projects show the platform, catalogue structure, product page templates, checkout and payment set-up, shipping integrations and speed work. Results usually cover conversion rate, checkout completion, average order value and the share of sales coming from mobile.
Mobile Apps

App write-ups show user journeys, key screens, the technology chosen, the admin panel and store listings. We report measures such as active users, retention after the first weeks, crash-free sessions and themes from genuine store reviews.
SEO

SEO projects show the audit findings, technical fixes, pages improved or created and the local work done. Results are taken from Search Console and analytics: clicks, impressions, enquiries from organic search and pages ranking for priority terms, always with dates.
Paid Ads

Paid campaigns show account structure, targeting, creative examples, landing pages and tracking set-up. We report spend, leads, cost per lead, lead quality from the sales team and, where tracked, cost per sale or return on ad spend.
Social Media

Social projects show the content plan, examples of posts and short videos, community-handling rules and reporting. Results focus on engagement quality, profile actions and enquiries or sales that can be traced to social channels.
Branding and Interfaces

Branding and interface projects show research findings, concepts, the chosen direction, guidelines or design systems and the identity applied to real materials. Where interfaces were tested, we show what users struggled with and how the final design changed.
How Do We Measure Results Fairly?
Numbers in a portfolio are only useful if they are fair. These are the rules we follow when writing up results:

items: Baseline first: we state what the numbers were before our work started, over a comparable period.
Same period comparisons: seasonal businesses are compared year on year, not month on month.
Clear attribution: when several things changed at once, such as a new website and a price cut, we say so and do not claim the whole effect.
Source named: each figure is tied to the tool it came from, such as analytics, Search Console, an ad platform, a store dashboard or the CRM.
Ranges when needed: if a client prefers not to share exact figures, we use ranges or percentages and say that we have done so.
No cherry-picking: we do not publish a single good week as if it were a lasting result.

main_content.text: Featured Case Studies

Note: Case study cards are placed here only from real, client-approved projects that follow the structure above (see the implementation notes in Part 6). Each card shows the client or anonymised description, service, industry, timeline, one or two verified results with their source, and a link to the full case study.

Our featured work is chosen to show range rather than only the largest numbers. You will see small local businesses next to growing brands, and projects where the main result was time saved or a smoother process, not only traffic or revenue. If you are looking for work in a specific industry or service that is not shown here, ask us; we may be able to share an anonymised summary or arrange a reference call.
What a Full Case Study Includes

Each full case study page goes beyond the card. It typically shows before-and-after screenshots, the key decisions made during the project, a short timeline, the measured results with their source, the team members involved and, where the client agrees, a quote or short video. Where the client's data is confidential, we describe results as ranges or percentages and say so clearly.
How Do We Choose Which Projects to Feature?
A portfolio is a selection, so it is fair to ask how the selection is made. We feature projects that:

items: Have stable, measured outcomes rather than early or one-off spikes.
Show a range of business sizes, industries and services.
Illustrate a clear decision, such as choosing to repair rather than rebuild, or to start with organic search instead of ads.
Have written approval from the business owner for everything shown.
Remain accurate today; older projects are updated or retired when details change.

main_content.text: We do not feature only our largest or most flattering projects, because a small business owner learns more from a project like theirs than from a headline figure that does not apply to them.
What Does a Good Result Look Like?

"Good" depends on where a business starts. A modest change can be a big win for a small company, while a large company may measure success in efficiency rather than growth. This table shows the kind of outcomes we consider meaningful at different stages.

rows: More calls, messages and bookings; a site the owner can update
First paying users, retention after the first weeks, lower cost to acquire users
Higher conversion and order value, lower ad cost per sale, faster pages
Time saved, fewer errors, better adoption of internal tools, steady organic growth
Easier tasks for users, consistent identity, fewer support questions

main_content.text: Download Our Digital Marketing Portfolio PDF

Some readers prefer a document they can read offline, forward to a manager or attach to an internal approval. Our digital marketing portfolio PDF contains the same verified case studies as this page, in a compact format, plus a short overview of our services and process.

rows: Who we are, our one office in Bengaluru and how we work with clients remotely
The same verified projects shown on this page, in a printable layout
Short descriptions of each service and when it makes sense
How projects run, from audit to handover
How to reach us for a discovery call or references

main_content.text: To request the digital marketing portfolio PDF, use the contact form, call or message us on WhatsApp. We send it by email. We ask only for your name, email and what you are interested in, and we use those details only to send the PDF and follow up if you want us to. You can ask us to delete them at any time.
Why We Do Not Put Everything in One Public PDF

Some case studies include details that clients are happy to share privately but not publicly, such as revenue ranges or internal tools. For those, we may send a tailored version of the digital marketing portfolio PDF to a specific enquiry, with the client's permission, rather than publishing it to everyone.
How Do You Judge Any Digital Marketing Agency Portfolio?
Every agency portfolio looks impressive at first glance. These checks help you separate real evidence from decoration, whether you are looking at our work or anyone else's.

items: Are clients named, or at least described specifically enough to be believable?
Do results include a starting point, a time period and a data source?
Are screenshots and photos of the actual work, or generic stock images?
Are testimonials attributed to real people you could contact, with permission?
Do the numbers look suspiciously round or uniform across very different projects?
Is it clear what the agency did, as opposed to what the client or other vendors did?
Does the agency mention any project that did not go to plan, and what it learned?
Will the agency put you in touch with a past client for a reference call?

main_content.text: A digital marketing agency portfolio that passes these checks tells you far more than one with larger but unexplained numbers.
Warning Signs in a Portfolio

items: Results described as "verified" with no source or date.
The same photo used for different named people across a website.
Client logos shown without any case study or reference behind them.
Very large figures, such as total revenue generated for all clients, with no explanation of how they were calculated.
Testimonials with full names but no company, role or way to confirm them.

main_content.text: Why Are Honest Case Studies Important in India?

Beyond being good practice, honesty in case studies and testimonials is expected under Indian consumer rules. The Central Consumer Protection Authority's Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements, notified on 9 June 2022, say that claims about objectively verifiable facts should be capable of substantiation, and that endorsements should reflect the endorser's genuine and reasonably current opinion. The Bureau of Indian Standards published IS 19000:2022 on online consumer reviews in November 2022, which says purchased reviews must be clearly labelled and that reviews written by people employed for that purpose should not be published.

For us, that means three simple rules. Every number in a case study can be backed by the client's data. Every quote comes from the client, with permission, and reflects their real opinion. And no review, rating or testimonial on our site is bought, written by our staff or invented.
Logos, Screenshots and Privacy

Screenshots make case studies credible, but they can also expose private information. Before anything is published, we remove or blur customer names, phone numbers, emails, order details and anything else that could identify a person, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the business owner's own policies. Business logos appear only with written approval, and dashboards are cropped to show the relevant figures rather than whole accounts. If an owner later asks us to change or remove something, we do it promptly, on this page and in the PDF.
Our Approach Behind Every Project
The projects in this portfolio share the same way of working, which is often more useful to judge than any single result:

items: We start with an audit or discovery call, so the plan is based on facts rather than assumptions.
Every project has a written scope and an exact total before work starts.
Tracking and measurement are set up early, so results can be shown honestly later.
One team handles design, development and marketing, which reduces handoff problems.
Accounts, code, files and data stay in the owner's name throughout.
At the end, we hand over everything with clear notes and remain available for support if wanted.

main_content.text: Why Some of Our Projects Are Not Shown
Not every project can be public. Clients may have signed confidentiality agreements, may not want competitors to see their results, or may simply prefer privacy. In those cases we:

items: Leave the project out entirely, if the client prefers.
Publish an anonymised version that describes the industry and size without naming the client.
Share details privately with a prospective client, only with the original client's permission.
Never show logos, screenshots or quotes without written approval.

main_content.text: White-label work done for other agencies is never shown, because the end client did not hire us directly.
Questions to Ask Our Past Clients
When you speak to a reference, these questions will tell you more than any case study.

items: What was the situation before Afwan Tech started, and why did you choose them?
Did the team understand your business and ask the right questions?
Were deadlines, costs and scope clear and honoured?
How did they handle problems or changes during the project?
Did you receive all accounts, files and code at the end?
Would you hire them again, and for what kind of work?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Own Team Before Reviewing Portfolios
Agree internally on what you are looking for, so portfolio reviews lead to a decision:

items: Which problem are we trying to solve, and how will we measure success?
Which industries or project types are most relevant to us?
Who needs to approve the choice of agency, and what evidence will they want?
What budget range and timeline are realistic for us?

main_content.text: Three Typical Situations Portfolio Visitors Are In
These situations are illustrative, not case studies. They describe common reasons people visit this page, with details changed.
Situation 1: A Marketing Manager Building a Shortlist

A marketing manager at a mid-sized manufacturer (details changed) has been asked to shortlist three agencies for a website rebuild and SEO. She needs evidence she can forward to her director. The most useful steps are to request the portfolio PDF, look for B2B or manufacturing examples, and ask for a reference call with a similar client.
Situation 2: A Founder Checking If We Can Build Their App

A startup founder (details changed) has a prototype and wants to know whether we have built similar apps. Rather than only reading case studies, the fastest route is a short call where we walk through relevant work, explain what we would do differently for their product and share an anonymised example if a public one does not exist.
Situation 3: A Student Looking for a Portfolio Example

A digital marketing student (details changed) searches for a digital marketing portfolio PDF to model their own job portfolio on. Our portfolio can show how case studies are structured, and the section below gives practical tips for building a personal portfolio.
Building Your Own Digital Marketing Portfolio PDF
Many people searching for a digital marketing portfolio PDF are building their own, for a job or freelance work. The same principles we use apply to an individual portfolio:

items: Use the case-study structure: starting point, goal, what you did, results, what you learned.
Show real work, even small or personal projects, rather than made-up client stories.
State where each number came from, such as Google Analytics, Search Console or an ad platform, and the time period.
Include screenshots of dashboards, ads or content you created, with sensitive data hidden.
Keep it short: four to six strong examples beat twenty weak ones.
Add certifications only if you actually hold them, with a link to verify.
Export the final document as a PDF with readable fonts and compressed images, and keep a web version too.

main_content.text: If you are early in your career and want to see how an agency structures its work, you are welcome to request our PDF as a reference.
How Long Should You Spend Reviewing Portfolios?

Choosing a partner is important, but reviewing portfolios endlessly rarely helps. A practical approach is to shortlist three providers, read two or three of each one's most relevant case studies, request their portfolio PDF or a short walkthrough, and speak to one reference each. That usually takes a week or two and gives far better evidence than browsing dozens of websites. Write down the same questions for every provider, so you compare like with like, and include the people who will approve the decision early.
Common Mistakes When Reading or Publishing Case Studies
These mistakes lead to poor agency choices or to case studies that hurt rather than help.

items: Choosing an agency because of one large headline figure without checking its source.
Ignoring the timeline, so results achieved over years are compared with promises made for months.
Treating client logos as proof of work, without asking what was actually done.
Publishing results without the client's written permission.
Rounding or inflating numbers to look more impressive.
Using stock photos for team members or clients.
Leaving out the starting point, so readers cannot judge the improvement.

main_content.text: What This Page Does Not Do
To keep this portfolio trustworthy, we do not:

items: Publish numbers we cannot back with the client's data.
Use stock photos to represent clients, team members or testimonials.
Show logos of companies we have not worked with directly.
Pay for, write or edit client reviews or testimonials.
Present illustrative examples as real case studies.
Share confidential client information without permission.

main_content.text: When Our Portfolio May Not Be the Right Guide
Our portfolio reflects the kind of work we do. It may be less useful if:

items: You need TV, radio, print or outdoor advertising, which we do not offer.
You need a very large enterprise platform with hundreds of integrations; ask us for a frank conversation about fit.
You need a specialist in a single platform we do not work with; we will say so and suggest looking elsewhere.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some projects need special handling when they appear in a portfolio.
Projects Built for Other Agencies
Some of our development work is done for other agencies under their brand. That work is never shown here, because the end client did not hire us directly and may not know who built it.
Projects Still in Progress
For ongoing work, we wait until results are stable before publishing. Early numbers can change quickly, and publishing too soon can mislead.
Results That Fell Short
Some projects do not hit their targets. Where the client agrees, we still publish what happened and what we learned, because it shows how we respond when things go wrong.
Regulated Industries
For healthcare, finance and education clients, case studies avoid health or financial claims and focus on process, design and technical work, with wording approved by the client's compliance team.
Multi-Vendor Projects
When several agencies worked on a project, we describe only our part and credit the others where the client agrees.
What Happens After You Review the Portfolio?

If something here looks relevant, the next step is a short discovery call. We ask about your goals, your current website or product, your timeline and budget range, then walk you through the most relevant examples in more detail, including any anonymised work we can share. If it makes sense, we propose a free audit of your website, store, app or accounts, followed by a written plan with the exact total. If our work is not the right fit, we will tell you, and where possible point you to the kind of specialist you need.
Making This Page and the PDF Accessible

We want everyone to be able to review our work. Screenshots on this page carry descriptive alternative text, case study text is real text rather than words inside images, and colours meet contrast guidelines. The PDF version uses tagged headings, readable fonts and compressed images, so it opens quickly on phones and works with screen readers. If you need the portfolio in another format, ask us and we will help.
Examples People Ask For Most Often
Some requests come up again and again when people review our work. If any of these match your needs, mention them when you contact us and we will prioritise the most relevant examples:

items: A business website rebuilt so the owner's team can edit it, with search rankings protected during the move.
A local business that started getting more calls after its profile, website and ads were fixed together.
An online store moved to a new platform without losing product pages from search results.
An internal tool that replaced spreadsheets for orders, stock or approvals.
A mobile app built with an admin panel, published under the owner's own store accounts.
A brand refresh carried across website, social media and printed materials.

main_content.text: Where a public write-up does not exist yet, we can walk you through the work on a call, showing only what the owner has agreed to share.
Working With Us From Anywhere

All the projects in this portfolio were run from our one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, with many owners based in other cities and countries. Work happens through video calls, shared project boards, review links for designs and staging sites, and regular written updates. Owners in Bengaluru can meet us in person by appointment. We do not have branch offices elsewhere and do not describe any project as delivered from a local office we do not have.
Industries We Have Worked With

Our work spans small local businesses and growing companies in sectors such as professional services, healthcare and clinics, education and coaching, retail and e-commerce, manufacturing and distribution, real estate, hospitality and software. Specific industries appear in the case studies only where we have client permission to show them. If your industry is not listed, ask us; relevant experience is sometimes covered by confidentiality.
Why Trust This Portfolio?
We would rather earn trust through evidence than through badges. Here is what stands behind every case study in our digital marketing agency portfolio:

items: Numbers backed by the client's own data, with source and time period.
Written client permission for names, logos, screenshots and quotes.
Real screenshots and photos, never stock images.
Honest notes on what worked and what did not.
Reference calls with past clients for serious enquiries.
Consistent structure, so you can compare projects fairly.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Portfolio
What is a digital marketing agency portfolio?
It is a collection of real projects showing what an agency did, for whom and with what measured result. A good one names its data sources and has client permission.
Can I download your digital marketing portfolio PDF?
Yes. Request it through the contact form, by phone or on WhatsApp, and we will email you the PDF with the same verified case studies shown on this page.
What information do you need to send the PDF?
Only your name, email and what you are interested in. We use them to send the PDF and follow up if you wish, and we delete them on request.
How do you verify the results in your case studies?
Results come from the client's own analytics, ad accounts, Search Console, store or CRM data, and we state the source and time period for each number.
Do your clients approve their case studies?
Yes. Every named client approves the case study, including names, logos, screenshots and quotes, in writing before it is published.
Why are some case studies anonymised?
Some clients have confidentiality agreements or prefer privacy. We then describe the industry and size without naming them, or leave the project out.
Are your testimonials real?
Yes. Every testimonial comes from a real client, in their own words, with permission. We never write, buy or edit reviews.
Do you include projects that did not go well?
Where the client agrees, yes. We include what we learned, because honest lessons are often more useful than only showing wins.
What are marketing case studies with solutions?
They are case studies that show the problem and the solution side by side: the starting point, what was done and the measured result, so readers can learn from the approach.
Can I speak to one of your past clients?
Yes, for serious enquiries. We arrange a reference call with a past client who has agreed to speak with prospective clients.
Do you have case studies in my industry?
Possibly. If none are shown, ask us; we may be able to share an anonymised summary or arrange a reference with the original client's permission.
Why do you not show client revenue figures?
Many clients keep revenue private. We show revenue only when the client approves, and otherwise report measures such as enquiries, conversion rates or time saved.
I am a student. Can I use your portfolio as a reference for my own?
Yes. Our case-study structure is a useful model, and this page includes tips for building your own digital marketing portfolio PDF with real, verifiable work.
Do you show white-label work done for other agencies?
No. Work done on behalf of other agencies is never shown, because the end client did not hire us directly.
How often is the portfolio updated?
We add new case studies when projects have stable, approved results, and we review existing ones so that the information stays accurate.
How do I start a project after reviewing your portfolio?
Call or WhatsApp 79798 50684, email contactafwantech@gmail.com or use the contact form. We start with a short discovery call and, for most services, a free audit.

bottom_content.text: Case Studies and a Digital Marketing Portfolio PDF Built on Evidence

**Afwan Tech** publishes its digital marketing agency portfolio with one simple rule: every number must be backed by the owner's own data, and every name, logo, screenshot and quote must be approved in writing. Our case studies cover website development, custom software, online stores, mobile apps, SEO, paid ads, social media and branding, and each one follows the same structure, from the starting point and goal to the work done, the measured results and what we learned along the way.

People looking for marketing case studies with solutions usually want to see the problem and the fix side by side. That is why every write-up states the situation before we started, the approach we chose and why, the specific deliverables and the outcome, with the data source and time period for each figure. Where a business prefers privacy, we publish an anonymised version or leave the project out.

If you prefer a document you can read offline or share with colleagues, request our digital marketing portfolio PDF. It contains the same verified case studies as this page, a short company overview, service summaries and our process, and we send it by email after a quick request through the contact form, a call or WhatsApp. We ask only for the details needed to send it.

Honesty in case studies is also expected under Indian consumer rules. The Central Consumer Protection Authority's 2022 guidelines on misleading advertisements expect claims to be capable of substantiation and endorsements to reflect genuine opinions, and the Bureau of Indian Standards' IS 19000:2022 standard on online reviews says purchased reviews must be labelled. We go further: no review, rating or testimonial on our site is bought, written by our staff or invented, and no stock photo stands in for a real person.

When judging any portfolio, including ours, check for named or clearly described projects, results with a baseline and time period, real screenshots, contactable references and an honest account of what did not go to plan. For serious enquiries, we arrange reference calls with past owners who have agreed to speak with prospective partners.

We choose which projects to feature for range, not only size. You will find small local businesses next to growing brands, and projects where the main win was time saved or a smoother process rather than traffic. Each case study is reviewed regularly and retired when details are no longer accurate. Screenshots are cropped and blurred so that no customer's personal data is ever exposed, and owners can ask us to change or remove anything at any time, on the page and in the PDF version of this digital marketing portfolio.
Students and job seekers building their own portfolio can use the same structure: real work, clear sources for every number, short write-ups and a compact PDF with a web version alongside it.

After reviewing our work, the next step is a short discovery call where we walk through the most relevant examples and, for most services, offer a free audit. We have one office and work with businesses across India and abroad. Contact **Afwan Tech**, ITPL Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 79798 50684. Email: contactafwantech@gmail.com.
