Choosing the Right Social Media Marketing Services Partner
Comparing providers of social media marketing services is easier with a few clear checks. Look past the portfolio images and ask how the work is done.

rows: Goals, audience and platform choice explained in writing
A fixed number of posts sold to every client
Real photos and videos of your business
Clear reply hours and escalation rules
Pages and ad accounts in your name

main_content.text: Good social media marketing services should also connect to the rest of your marketing, so attention on social becomes visits, enquiries and sales elsewhere. And the people providing your social media marketing services should be willing to tell you when a channel is not worth the effort.
Social Media Services for One-Off Needs

Not every business needs a monthly retainer. Our social media services also include one-off work: setting up or cleaning up business pages, creating a brand kit for social, producing a launch campaign, training your team, or auditing what is working. These are scoped separately and handed over with simple guides so your team can continue.
LinkedIn for B2B Companies and Founders

For business-to-business companies, LinkedIn is often the most valuable channel, because buyers, partners and future employees spend time there. Company pages work best alongside personal profiles of founders and senior staff, whose posts usually reach more people than the page itself. We help with:

items: Company page set-up, showcase pages where relevant, and consistent branding.
Topic plans for founders and experts, based on their real knowledge and views.
Editing posts, carousels and short videos for their approval.
Employee advocacy guidelines, so team members can share company news comfortably.
Event, webinar and hiring campaigns, measured on sign-ups and applications.

main_content.text: WhatsApp Business and Customer Messages

Many Indian customers move from a social post straight to WhatsApp. We set up WhatsApp Business profiles, quick replies, catalogues and greeting messages, and connect click-to-chat buttons from your posts and website. Promotional messages should go only to people who have agreed to receive them, in line with WhatsApp's policies and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We help design opt-in messages and keep broadcast lists clean, while your team handles the actual conversations or follows the reply rules we agree together.
How Do We Handle Data, Privacy and Consent?

Social media work touches personal information: names in comments, messages, lead forms and customer lists used for ads. We keep it simple and careful. Access to your accounts is given through each platform's business roles, not shared passwords. Lead-form data goes straight to you or your CRM. Customer lists are used for targeting only when your notices and consent allow it. And when a team member leaves, access is removed the same day.
How Do Paid Social Ads Fit With Organic Posting?

Organic posts build trust with people who already follow you, but most platforms show unpaid posts to only a fraction of followers. Paid campaigns extend reach to new people who match your customers, retarget people who visited your website and support launches, events and offers. We usually recommend a small, steady paid budget alongside organic content once the page has enough good posts to impress new visitors. Detailed campaign management sits with our paid ads team.
Influencer Collaborations and the Rules in India

Influencer partnerships can help a brand reach new audiences, but they come with clear rules. The Department of Consumer Affairs' "Endorsement Know-hows!" guide, released in January 2023, says influencers must disclose any material connection with a brand, such as payment, free products, trips or discounts, clearly and prominently within the post, using simple labels such as "advertisement", "sponsored" or "paid promotion". In August 2023, the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) added that health and finance influencers must hold relevant qualifications or registrations, such as SEBI registration for investment advice, and show them prominently.

When we plan influencer work, we check that creators disclose partnerships properly, that claims about your product are true and approved by you, and that health or finance content is handled only by qualified voices. Your legal adviser should confirm what applies to your category.
Growing the Right Audience, Not Just More Followers
A large following of the wrong people is worth less than a small following of likely customers. We focus growth on quality:

items: Content aimed at specific customer problems, not generic trends.
Collaborations with genuine local partners, suppliers and complementary brands.
Paid promotion targeted at people similar to your real customers, when budgets allow.
Clear profile information: what you do, where you serve and how to contact you.
Consistent replies, which encourage more people to comment and share.

main_content.text: We watch who is following and engaging, not just how many, and adjust content when the audience drifts away from the customers you want.
Accessible and Inclusive Posts

Good posts work for everyone. We add captions to videos, write descriptive alt text where platforms allow it, keep text on images short and readable, use strong colour contrast and avoid putting important information only in small print. Inclusive content also reaches people who scroll with the sound off or in bright sunlight, which is most people at some point.
What We Need From You

The best social content comes from inside the business. To keep the calendar running smoothly, we usually ask for one person who can approve the monthly plan, regular access to your team or products for photos and short videos, quick notice of offers, events and launches, and clear rules about which customer questions or complaints must go to a senior person. With those in place, the work runs with very little of your time each week.
What Will You See in Our Social Media Reports?
Likes are pleasant, but they are not the goal. Our reports start with business outcomes and then explain the signals behind them.

rows: Messages, lead forms, tracked links, your CRM
People moving from interest to action
How many people saw your content
Whether content is genuinely useful or interesting
Whether the right people are joining

main_content.text: Each report ends with what we learned and what we will change next month, in plain language.
Keeping Up With Platform Changes

Platforms change features, formats and algorithms regularly. A format that worked last year can lose reach today. We review platform announcements and our own clients' results each month, test new formats on a small scale before shifting the whole calendar, and explain any change in approach in the monthly report. That way your plan adapts steadily instead of chasing every trend.
What Does the Total Cost Depend On?
We do not publish fixed fees on this page, because social media needs vary widely. The total for any plan depends on:

items: Number of platforms and posts per month on each.
Content mix: static posts, carousels, stories, reels or long videos.
Shoots: whether we shoot on location, edit your footage or design from existing assets.
Community management hours and expected message volume.
Languages: English only or additional Indian languages.
Paid social: management of campaigns, with ad spend paid directly by you to the platforms.
Influencer coordination, if needed.

main_content.text: Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your goals and channels, in writing, before work starts.
Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A CafÃ© With Followers but Few Visits

A neighbourhood cafÃ© (details changed) has a pretty Instagram feed but quiet weekday afternoons. We would plan reels around weekday offers and new menu items, add location tags and opening hours to every post, reply quickly to messages about table bookings and track redemptions of a social-only offer at the counter.
Situation 2: A B2B Firm Invisible on LinkedIn

An engineering consultancy (details changed) has a company page with occasional job posts and no clear voice. We would build a LinkedIn plan around project stories, short explainers from senior engineers and the founder's perspective on industry changes, posting from both the company page and key people's profiles with their approval.
Situation 3: A Skincare Brand Planning Influencer Launches

A new skincare brand (details changed) wants to work with creators for its launch. We would shortlist creators whose audiences match, brief them with approved claims only, check that every post carries a clear paid-partnership disclosure, and measure results with tracked links and discount codes rather than reach alone.
Common Mistakes in Social Media Marketing
These mistakes waste effort and sometimes damage a brand's reputation.

items: Trying to be on every platform at once and doing none of them well.
Posting without goals, so nobody knows whether social is working.
Using only stock images and templates that look like every competitor.
Ignoring comments and messages, or replying days later.
Buying followers or engagement, which damages reach and trust.
Letting a freelancer or agency own your page, ad account or login.
Running influencer posts without clear paid-partnership disclosure.
Making claims about health, finance or results that the business cannot prove.
Judging success by follower count alone.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Before You Hire a Social Media Agency
Ask any provider these questions, including us. Clear written answers are a good sign.

items: Which platforms do you recommend for my business, and why those?
Who will create the content, and will you shoot real photos and videos of my business?
How does the approval process work before anything is posted?
Who will reply to comments and messages, during which hours, and how are complaints escalated?
Will my pages, accounts and content files stay in my name?
What will you report on each month, and how do you connect social activity to enquiries or sales?
How do you handle influencer disclosure and claims?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Own Team
Social media depends on input from inside the business. Before starting, agree:

items: Who will approve the monthly calendar, and how quickly?
Who can appear on camera, and who will share project photos or customer stories?
Which questions or complaints must always be passed to a senior person?
What offers, events or launches are planned for the next few months?

main_content.text: What This Service Does Not Do
To keep expectations clear, our social media service does not:

items: Guarantee a number of followers, views, leads or viral posts.
Buy followers, likes, comments or fake engagement.
Publish anything without your approval of the monthly calendar or agreed rules.
Use images, music or fonts you do not have the right to use.
Make health, financial or result claims you have not approved and cannot prove.
Run undisclosed influencer promotions.
Hold your pages, accounts or content in our name.
Give legal advice; your adviser confirms rules for your category.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need Us
We would rather tell you honestly when a monthly social media plan is not the right spend.

items: If your customers do not use social platforms to discover or choose businesses like yours, focus on search, referrals or sales outreach.
If you cannot provide any access to your team, products or work, content will be generic and less effective.
If you only need a few posts for a single event, a one-off package is better value than a retainer.
If your website, booking or WhatsApp follow-up is broken, fix that first, so social attention turns into customers.
If you have an in-house creator, a strategy session and monthly review may be all you need.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some brands need extra planning. We treat these separately.
Restarting a Dormant Page

Many businesses have pages that have not posted for months or years, sometimes with old phone numbers and unanswered reviews. We start by fixing profile details, replying to old reviews and messages where it still makes sense, removing outdated offers and pinning a fresh introduction post. Then we rebuild a steady rhythm before trying to grow reach.
Recovering a Hacked or Lost Account

If you lose access to a page, recovery depends on the platform's own process and on who was listed as an admin. We help gather proof of ownership and follow the official recovery steps, and afterwards we set up two-step login and business-level admin roles so it does not happen again.
Regulated Industries

Healthcare, finance, education and legal services face strict advertising standards and platform policies. We plan content with your compliance team, avoid unproven claims and make sure qualified people speak on specialist topics.
Crisis or Negative Comments

When a complaint goes public, speed and tone matter. We agree an escalation process in advance: what we can answer, what goes to your team and when to move a conversation to private messages. We never delete fair criticism to hide it, but we do remove spam and abuse according to platform rules.
Multi-Location Brands

Brands with several real branches may need a main page plus local posts or pages. We plan shared content with local variations, and we never create pages or listings for places where you have no presence.
Indian-Language Content
For audiences who prefer Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali or other languages, we write captions and video subtitles natively rather than translating word for word.
Personal Brands of Founders and Experts
Founder-led content on LinkedIn or YouTube can be powerful. We help plan topics and edit content, but the views must be genuinely the person's own, and they approve every post before it goes out.
About "Best Social Media Marketing Companies in India" Lists

You will find many lists of the best social media marketing companies in India. Some are paid placements, and none can tell you whether a team suits your brand. When comparing any social media marketing company in India, look at real pages the team manages, the quality of their own content, how they report results and whether accounts stay in your name. We do not claim a rank; we invite you to see how we work.
A Digital Marketing Agency for Social Media and Everything Around It

Social media works best when it connects with the rest of your marketing. As a digital marketing agency, social media is one part of what we do. The same team handles your website, search visibility and paid ads, so a reel can lead to a fast landing page, a search for your brand finds consistent information, and enquiries from every channel are tracked in one place. That joined-up view is often what turns social attention into steady business.
Why Choose Afwan Tech for Social Media Marketing Services?
We would rather earn trust through how we work than through badges. Here is what you can expect from our social media marketing services:

items: A written plan tied to business goals, not a fixed number of posts for everyone.
Real content about your business, people and work.
A monthly calendar you approve before anything goes live.
Honest reporting on enquiries and sales, not just likes.
Pages, accounts and content files in your name.
No fake followers, bought engagement or undisclosed promotions.
One team for social, ads, search and website when you need them together.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Social Media Marketing Services
What do social media marketing services include?
They include strategy, content calendars, design and short video, captions, publishing, community replies and monthly reporting. Paid social campaigns and influencer coordination can be added.
What is the difference between SMM services and social media management?
SMM services usually focus on growing reach and results, while social media management covers running the accounts day to day. Our offer combines both.
Which platforms do you manage?
Mainly Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube, plus others such as X or Pinterest where your audience genuinely is. We recommend platforms after the audit.
Do you create the content or do I provide it?
We create it with your input. We prefer real photos and videos of your business, which we can shoot, direct or edit, and we use stock images only where they genuinely fit.
Can I approve posts before they are published?
Yes. Each month's calendar is shared for your approval before anything goes live, and urgent posts follow a simple approval rule agreed in advance.
Do you reply to comments and messages?
Yes, during agreed hours. We answer common questions, pass sales and complaints to your team as agreed, and remove spam and abuse according to platform rules.
Are you a social media marketing agency for small business?
Yes. We work with clinics, cafÃ©s, salons, showrooms, coaching centres and other local businesses, focusing on a manageable posting rhythm and real enquiries.
Do you run paid social media ads?
Yes. Paid campaigns are managed by our paid ads team alongside organic posting, with ad spend paid directly by you to the platforms.
Do you work with influencers?
Yes. We shortlist suitable creators, brief them with approved claims and make sure every paid partnership is clearly disclosed, as Indian guidelines require.
Will you guarantee followers or viral posts?
No. Reach depends on platforms, content and audience behaviour. We commit to a clear plan, consistent quality and honest reporting.
Do you buy followers or likes?
Never. Bought followers and engagement damage reach and trust, and they break platform rules.
Will I own my pages and accounts?
Yes. Pages, accounts, ad accounts and content files stay in your business's name, and we are added with the access we need.
How long before social media shows results?
It depends on your starting point, content quality and consistency. Early signs such as better engagement often appear within the first months; steady enquiries take longer.
Can you create content in Indian languages?
Yes. We write captions and subtitles natively in Hindi and other Indian languages where your audience prefers them.
How much do your social media marketing services cost?
The total depends on platforms, posting volume, content type, shoots, community management and paid campaigns. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your goals.
Do you work with brands outside Bengaluru?
Yes. We have one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and work with brands across India and abroad through video calls, shared calendars and monthly reviews.

main_content.text: What Do Our Web Development Services Include?

Good web development services cover much more than writing code. When you hire us as your web development company, the project includes everything needed to go from an idea to a live, working site, and to keep it that way.

items: Discovery: your goals, customers, competitors, services and the action you want visitors to take.
Sitemap and content plan: which pages you need, what each should say and which search terms each page should own.
Wireframes and visual design: layout for desktop and mobile, brand colours, type and imagery.
Development: theme or front-end build, CMS set-up, forms, integrations and performance work.
Content entry: your text, images and documents placed, formatted and checked.
SEO foundations: titles, descriptions, headings, clean URLs, XML sitemap, redirects and structured data.
Tracking: Google Analytics, Search Console and conversion tracking for calls, forms and WhatsApp clicks.
Testing: real phones and browsers, forms, speed, accessibility checks and broken links.
Launch and handover: DNS, SSL, backups, a training session and a written guide for your team.

main_content.text: Website Design Services vs Website Development

People often use the two terms as if they mean the same thing, but they are different stages. Our website design services decide how the site looks and how a visitor moves through it. Development turns that design into a working site that loads fast, can be edited and connects to your other tools. We do both, which is why we describe our offer as web design development services rather than one or the other.

rows: Layout, look, navigation, page structure, calls to action
Code, CMS, forms, speed, security, integrations
Text, images, proof and offers on each page

main_content.text: What Should Professional Web Design Services Deliver?

"Professional" should mean more than a nice look. Professional web design services deliver a site that matches your brand, works on small screens first, uses readable type and contrast, and puts the most important information where visitors expect it. Each page should have one clear purpose and one main action. If a design looks impressive but makes it harder to find your phone number, it is not professional design.
Which Platform Is Right: WordPress, Drupal or a Custom Build?

There is no single best platform, and a web development company that recommends the same one to everyone is not listening. The right choice depends on who will edit the site, how complex it is, what it must connect to and how much you want to spend on upkeep. We recommend a platform only after discovery, and we explain why.

rows: Most business, service and content sites
Huge ecosystem, easy editing, many developers available
Needs regular updates; too many plugins slow it down
Large, structured sites with many content types, roles or languages
Strong permissions, flexible content modelling, mature security process
Fewer developers; more effort to build and maintain
Headless CMS with a custom front end
Sites that need top speed or must feed apps and other channels
Fast front end, content reused across platforms
Higher build effort; editors need a little training
Limited control, harder to scale or move later

main_content.text: WordPress is by far the most widely used content management system. W3Techs data reported in 2026 puts it at roughly four in ten of all websites. That popularity is a strength, because themes, plugins and help are easy to find, and a risk, because poorly maintained WordPress sites are common targets for attackers.
WordPress Development Services

Our WordPress development services cover new builds, theme development, block-editor (Gutenberg) layouts, plugin selection, speed work and migrations. As a WordPress development company we keep plugins to the minimum the site truly needs, use licensed themes or build our own, and set user roles so your team can edit content without breaking the layout.

Our WordPress website development services are a good fit for most companies that want to update pages, publish news or blogs and add landing pages without calling a developer. If you need a WordPress developer for a specific job, such as fixing a broken theme or speeding up a slow site, we take on those smaller tasks too.
A WordPress Website Design Agency That Also Writes the Code

Many studios design in a page builder and stop there. As a WordPress website design agency with in-house developers, we design each template for the block editor and build it cleanly, so pages stay fast and consistent as your team adds content over the years.
Drupal Website Development Services

Our Drupal website development services suit organisations with complex content: many departments, user roles, approval workflows or languages. We build on supported Drupal versions and help teams move off old ones. Drupal 7 reached its end of life on 5 January 2025, which means the Drupal Security Team no longer provides fixes for it. If your site still runs Drupal 7, planning a migration is the safest next step.
CMS Web Development Services and Headless Builds

Our CMS web development services go beyond WordPress and Drupal. For some projects we use a headless CMS, where editors manage content in one place and a fast custom front end displays it. This works well when content must also appear in a mobile app or on several sites. We only suggest it when the benefits clearly outweigh the extra build effort.
When a Fully Custom Build Makes Sense

If your site is really an application, with logins, dashboards, bookings, calculations or deep integrations, a custom build is usually better than forcing a CMS to do the job. That work is handled by our custom web development team.
What Types of Websites Do We Build?
We build sites for businesses at different stages. Each type has its own priorities, so we plan the structure differently.

rows: Mobile speed, clear services, local details, click-to-call and WhatsApp
One page per service, proof, short forms, conversion tracking
Trust with clients, investors, partners and job seekers
Clear structure, approvals, multiple editors, news and careers sections
Image optimisation, case-study templates, fast galleries
Reach customers in more than one language

main_content.text: Corporate Website Development

Corporate website development has extra needs. Several teams contribute content, legal and leadership approve pages, and the site often has sections for investors, media, careers and policies. We set up roles and approval steps in the CMS, create templates for each section, and document how the site should be updated so it stays consistent long after launch.
Website Redesign Services: When to Rebuild and When to Repair

Not every tired website needs a full rebuild, and an honest web development company will tell you so. Our website redesign services start with an audit that tells you whether repairing the current site is enough or a fresh build is better value.

rows: Site looks dated but works and ranks

main_content.text: How We Protect Rankings During a Redesign

A redesign is the most common way businesses lose search traffic. Before launch, we crawl the old site, map every old URL to its new home, keep titles and content that already rank, and set up 301 redirects. After launch, we watch Search Console for errors and fix anything that slips through.
How Does Our Website Development Process Work?
Every project follows the same eight stages. The order protects you: nothing is built before the plan is agreed, and nothing launches before it is tested.

items: Free audit and discovery call to understand your goals, current site and customers.
Written proposal with scope, platform recommendation, deliverables and the exact total.
Sitemap, content plan and wireframes for the key pages.
Visual design for desktop and mobile, with one round of changes built into the plan.
Development on a private staging site that you can review at any time.
Content entry, SEO foundations and tracking set-up.
Testing on real devices and browsers, followed by fixes.
Launch, redirects, backups, training and handover, then a post-launch check.

Most delays in a website project come from waiting, not from building. To keep things moving, we ask for a few things early: one decision-maker who can approve designs and content, access to your domain and hosting accounts, your logo and brand files, and draft text for the main pages (or a brief if you want us to write it). We share a simple tracker so you always know what is with us and what is with you. When feedback arrives within the agreed time, the schedule in the proposal holds; when it does not, we update the dates with you in writing.

Note: these stages are indicative only. Actual timelines depend on the number of pages and features, how quickly content and feedback arrive, integrations and approvals. We confirm a schedule in the written proposal.

main_content.text: What Standards Does Every Website We Build Meet?

We build every site to the same baseline, whatever the platform. These are targets we design and test for, not guarantees, because real-world results also depend on hosting, content and plugins you add later.
Speed and Core Web Vitals
Google's Core Web Vitals measure how real visitors experience a page. We aim for the "good" range on each metric and check field data in Search Console after launch.

rows: How quickly the main content appears
How quickly the page responds to taps and clicks
How much the layout jumps while loading

main_content.text: Mobile First

Google announced in 2024 that it was completing its move to mobile-first indexing, which means it mainly uses the mobile version of a site for indexing and ranking. We design the mobile layout first and make sure the mobile and desktop versions carry the same content.
Accessibility

We follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, which became a W3C Recommendation on 6 October 2023 and added nine new success criteria. In practice that means readable contrast, keyboard access, clear focus states, labelled forms, alt text and tap targets large enough for thumbs. We do automated and manual checks, but we do not issue legal accessibility certificates.
Security and Reliability

items: HTTPS on every page, with automatic certificate renewal where the host supports it.
Supported platform versions, licensed themes and plugins, and no pirated or "nulled" software.
Strong admin passwords, two-step login for admins and limited user roles.
Automated off-site backups and a tested restore process when you take a care plan.
Contact forms protected from spam without blocking real users.

main_content.text: Search Foundations

items: One H1 per page, logical headings and descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
Clean, readable URLs and an XML sitemap submitted to Search Console.
Structured data that matches what is visible on the page.
Server-rendered content, so search engines and AI tools can read it without running scripts.
Internal links between related pages, and 301 redirects for any URL that changes.

main_content.text: WordPress Website Management Services: Care After Launch

A website is never truly finished. Software needs updates, content goes out of date and small problems appear. Our WordPress website management services handle the routine website maintenance that keeps a site healthy, so you can focus on your business. We offer similar care for Drupal and custom sites.

items: Core, theme and plugin updates, tested on staging before they go live.
Daily or weekly backups stored off the server, with periodic restore tests.
Uptime monitoring and security scans, with alerts handled by our team.
Small content edits, new pages from existing templates and image updates.
A short monthly report: what was updated, any issues found and suggested improvements.
Speed and Core Web Vitals checks after major changes.

main_content.text: You can stop a care plan at any time. Because you own every account, moving to another provider or in-house team is simple, and we provide a handover note when you do.
What Does the Total Cost Depend On?
We do not publish fixed prices on this page, because two websites that look similar can need very different work. The total is made up of a few clear parts:

items: Number of pages and unique page templates.
Platform and features: forms, bookings, search, filters, multiple languages, member areas.
Design depth: adapting an existing brand or creating a new visual system.
Content: whether you provide text and images or need us to write, photograph or source them.
Integrations with CRM, payment, email marketing, ERP or other tools.
Migration: moving content, users and URLs from an old site.
Third-party costs: domain, hosting, premium themes or plugins and licensed images, paid to those providers.
Ongoing care, if you choose a care plan after launch.

main_content.text: Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements, in writing, before work starts.
Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Consultancy With a Site Nobody Can Edit

A small accounting consultancy (details changed) has a site built in a heavy page builder by a freelancer who no longer replies. Every text change breaks the layout. We would rebuild it on WordPress with block-editor templates for services, team and articles, move the existing content, redirect old URLs and train two staff members to edit pages safely.
Situation 2: An Institute Still Running Drupal 7

A training institute (details changed) runs a large Drupal 7 site with courses, faculty profiles and an admissions section. With Drupal 7 no longer supported, the site is a security risk. We would audit the content types and modules, plan a migration to a supported Drupal version or another suitable platform, move content in stages and redirect every old course URL.
Situation 3: A Manufacturer Moving From Brochure to Enquiries

A component manufacturer (details changed) has a five-page site with no product information. Buyers call to ask basic questions. We would plan product category pages with specifications and downloadable data sheets, add a request-a-quote form, set up conversion tracking and structure the pages so they can rank for the products buyers actually search for.
Common Mistakes When Building or Redesigning a Website
These mistakes cost businesses time, money and search traffic. Most are easy to avoid if you know about them early.

items: Registering the domain or hosting in the developer's name instead of your own.
Choosing a theme for its demo pictures, then finding it slow and hard to edit with real content.
Installing dozens of plugins for small features that could be built simply or skipped.
Launching a redesign without redirecting old URLs, losing years of rankings overnight.
Writing content after the design is finished, so the text never fits the layout.
Using pirated themes or plugins, which often contain hidden malware.
Testing only on a desktop when most visitors arrive on phones.
Forgetting tracking, so nobody knows which pages produce enquiries.
Having no update or backup plan after launch.

main_content.text: How Do You Choose the Right Web Development Company?

Choosing a web development company is less about finding the cheapest quote and more about finding a team that understands what your site must achieve. A useful way to compare providers is to look at four things: how they plan, how they build, how they hand over and how they support you after launch.

rows: They ask about your customers, services and goals before talking about design
They send a price before understanding the project

They push one platform for every client
They talk about speed, accessibility, security and clean code
They only show pretty home-page designs
Domain, hosting and code are in your name
They insist on registering everything themselves
No documentation; you depend on them for every change
Clear options for updates and fixes after launch
Vague promises or no plan after go-live

main_content.text: A web development company that also understands search and conversion will usually save you money over the life of the site, because pages are structured to rank and to turn visitors into enquiries from day one. That is the gap we try to close: our developers, designers and SEO specialists work as one team, so you do not pay one web development company to build and another agency to fix what was built.
Responsive Website Design as a Basic Requirement

A responsive website adapts its layout to any screen, from a small phone to a wide monitor. Today this is not an extra; it is the minimum. We design responsive layouts with flexible grids, images sized for each screen, readable text without zooming and buttons large enough to tap. We then test each template on real phones and tablets, not just a desktop browser window.
Website Design Solutions for Different Budgets

Every business has limits on time and money, so we offer website design solutions at different levels of depth. A small business may start with a carefully adapted theme and a handful of strong pages; a larger company may need a custom design system with dozens of templates. In both cases, the web development company you hire should be able to explain what you get at each level and what you would give up.
Questions to Ask Before You Hire a Web Development Company
Ask any provider these questions, including us. A good partner will answer clearly and in writing.

items: Which platform do you recommend for my site, and why that one?
Will the domain, hosting, code and design files be in my name from day one?
How many plugins or third-party tools will the site use, and who maintains them?
How will you protect my current rankings if this is a redesign?
What speed and accessibility checks do you run before launch?
How many rounds of design changes are included?
Who will be my main contact, and how often will I get updates?
What happens after launch if something breaks?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Own Team and Hosting Provider
Some answers sit with you, not with us. Before the project starts, check:

items: Who in your team will approve designs and content, and who will edit the site later?
Who controls the domain registrar account and the business email linked to it?
Does your current host provide backups, staging and PHP or database versions that the new site needs?
Are there legal pages, licences or compliance texts your lawyer must approve?

main_content.text: What This Service Does Not Do
To keep expectations clear, our website development service does not:

items: Guarantee a particular Google ranking, traffic level or number of leads.
Copy a competitor's design or content, or use images and fonts you do not have the right to use.
Use pirated, cracked or "nulled" themes and plugins.
Cover full online stores; those are handled by our e-commerce development service.
Cover complex web applications; those are handled by our custom web development service.
Include ongoing SEO campaigns or paid ads, which are separate services.
Provide legal advice or certify legal compliance for privacy, accessibility or industry rules.
Lock you in. We never keep your domain, code or content hostage.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need Us
We would rather tell you honestly when a full website project is not the right spend.

items: If you need a one-page site for a short event, a hosted website builder is quicker and cheaper.
If your current site is fast, secure and converts well, better content and SEO may help more than a redesign.
If you only need a small fix, such as a broken form, ask for a one-off task instead of a new build.
If you have an in-house developer, a design-only engagement or an audit may be all you need.
If you are not yet sure what you sell or to whom, talk to customers before investing in a site.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some projects need extra care. We plan for these separately.
Hacked or Infected Websites

If your site shows spam pages, redirects visitors or is flagged as unsafe, we first take a backup for evidence, clean the infection, close the hole that let it in, update everything and request a review in Search Console where needed. Then we decide together whether a rebuild is safer.
Moving From a Website Builder

Moving from a hosted builder to WordPress or another CMS means exporting content, rebuilding templates and redirecting URLs. Some builders limit exports, so we check what can be moved automatically before quoting.
Indian-Language and Multilingual Sites
For sites in Hindi, Kannada, Tamil or other languages, we choose fonts that render well, plan translated URLs, add hreflang tags and make sure forms accept non-English input.
Sites With Specific Compliance Needs

If your site must follow rules set by a regulator, a funding body or a government department, tell us at the start. We confirm the current requirements with you and your adviser before design begins, rather than assuming what applies.
Very Large Content Migrations
For sites with thousands of pages, we migrate in batches with scripts, check samples by hand and keep the old site available on a staging address until every redirect is confirmed.

Design, development, SEO foundations and tracking handled by one team.

What does a web development company do?

A web development company plans, designs, builds, tests and launches websites, and often maintains them afterwards. It turns your goals and content into a fast, secure site that visitors can use and search engines can read.

mainEntity.name: What does a web development company do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A web development company plans, designs, builds, tests and launches websites, and often maintains them afterwards. It turns your goals and content into a fast, secure site that visitors can use and search engines can read.

mainEntity.name: What is included in your website development services?

mainEntity.name: Do you build websites on WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. WordPress is our most common choice for business and content sites because it is easy to edit and widely supported. We keep plugins to a minimum and use licensed themes or our own.

mainEntity.name: Are you a WordPress development company or do you use other platforms too?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are a WordPress development company, and we also build on Drupal, headless CMS set-ups and custom code. We recommend a platform after discovery, based on your content, editors and integrations.

mainEntity.name: Will a new website or redesign affect my Google rankings?

mainEntity.name: Do you offer WordPress website management services after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our care plans cover updates, backups, uptime and security monitoring, small edits and a short monthly report. You can stop at any time.

mainEntity.name: Do you build corporate websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our corporate website development includes sections for services, news, careers, investors or policies, with user roles and approval steps so several teams can contribute safely.

mainEntity.name: Will I own my website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The domain, hosting account, code, design files and content are yours, and we can work entirely inside accounts registered in your name.

mainEntity.name: Will my website work well on mobile phones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We design the mobile layout first, test on real phones and aim for Google's "good" Core Web Vitals thresholds for loading, responsiveness and layout stability.

acceptedAnswer.text: The total depends on pages, features, design depth, content, integrations, migration and third-party costs. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.

faqs.q: What is CRM software?
faqs.a: CRM software is a customer relationship management system that stores leads, customers, interactions, deals and service requests in one place. It helps teams follow up on time and gives managers clear reports.

faqs.q: What are some CRM software examples?
faqs.a: Well-known examples include Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Freshsales, LeadSquared, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive and Kylas, plus service platforms such as Servitium CRM. Each suits different business sizes and processes.

faqs.q: Which is the best CRM software in India?
faqs.a: There is no single best option for every business. The right choice fits your process, connects to your channels, is easy for your team and is affordable to run over several years.

faqs.q: What is the difference between CRM tools and a CRM system?
faqs.a: The terms are often used interchangeably. CRM tools usually means individual products or features, while a CRM system often refers to the complete setup, including integrations, data and workflows.

faqs.q: Do you build custom CRM software?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build custom platforms around your process, with web and mobile access, and you own the code and data.

faqs.q: Can you customise Zoho, HubSpot or Salesforce?
faqs.a: Yes, we can configure and integrate ready-made products. We are not an official partner or reseller of these brands unless a verified badge is shown.

faqs.q: What is Servitium CRM?
faqs.a: Servitium CRM is a service management platform from Path Infotech Limited covering complaints, warranties, AMC and field service. Afwan Tech is not connected with it.

faqs.q: What is Butterfly CRM?
faqs.a: Searches for Butterfly CRM usually relate to a brand's service portal or a similarly named product. For appliance service, use the brand's official channels; for a business service CRM, we can help you choose or build one.

faqs.q: How long does a CRM project take?
faqs.a: It depends on the route, features, integrations and data. Configuring a ready-made product is fastest, while custom builds are delivered in phases; we confirm a schedule after discovery.

faqs.q: How much does CRM software cost?
faqs.a: The total depends on the route, users, features, integrations, data migration and third-party subscriptions. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.

faqs.q: Can the CRM connect to WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. Through the WhatsApp Business Platform, incoming messages can create or update records and approved templates can send updates to customers who have opted in.

faqs.q: Can you move our data from Excel or another CRM?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean, de-duplicate and map your data, then import it and check a sample with your team before launch.

faqs.q: Will we own our data and code?
faqs.a: Yes. Your data always belongs to you, and for custom builds you also own the source code, database and hosting accounts.

faqs.q: Is our customer data safe?
faqs.a: We use role-based access, audit logs, two-factor login, encryption and tested backups, and design consent and deletion features with India's DPDP Act in mind.

faqs.q: Do you provide a mobile CRM app?
faqs.a: Yes. We build Android and iPhone apps for field sales and service teams, including visit logging, photos, signatures and offline use where needed.

faqs.q: How do I start?
faqs.a: Call or WhatsApp 79798 50684, or email contactafwantech@gmail.com, to book a free consultation. We will map your process and recommend the simplest suitable option.

main_content.text: Build, Customise or Integrate Your CRM Software
Custom CRM development, setup of ready-made CRM tools and integrations with WhatsApp, calling, website forms and accounting, from one team in Bengaluru.

CRM software (customer relationship management software) is a system that keeps every lead, customer, conversation, deal and service request in one place, so sales, marketing and support teams follow up on time and managers see what is happening. Afwan Tech builds custom CRM software, configures ready-made CRM tools such as Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce or Freshsales, and connects your CRM system to the channels Indian customers actually use: WhatsApp, phone calls, website forms and payment links.

Most businesses come to us with the same problem: enquiries scattered across spreadsheets, WhatsApp chats, email and notebooks, leads that nobody calls back and no clear view of which source brings paying customers. Whether the answer is a ready-made product, a customised setup or a system built from scratch, we recommend the simplest option that fits, and we tell you honestly when an off-the-shelf tool is enough. Because we also run SEO, paid ads and social media campaigns, we understand where your leads come from and how to track them all the way to revenue.

main_content.text: What Is CRM Software?

What is CRM software in simple terms? It is the shared memory of your business. Every time someone fills a form, calls, sends a WhatsApp message, buys, raises a complaint or renews, the system records it against that person or company. Your team can then see the full history before the next conversation, get reminders for follow-ups, and move each opportunity through clear stages until it closes.

A good CRM system answers everyday questions quickly: Who called yesterday and has not been contacted? Which salesperson has the most overdue follow-ups? How many leads came from Google Ads this month and how many became customers? Which service tickets are about to breach their promised time?
The Three Main Types

rows: Day-to-day sales, marketing and service work: leads, deals, tickets, tasks and automation
Sales teams, support desks, field staff
Reports, dashboards, forecasts and customer segments built from the data
Sharing customer information across departments, partners and channels
Businesses with dealers, branches or several teams

main_content.text: Most modern platforms combine all three. The difference between products is usually depth in one area, ease of use, integrations and how well they fit your industry.
What a CRM System Does Day to Day

items: Captures leads automatically from your website, landing pages, Google and Meta lead forms, calls and WhatsApp.
Assigns each lead to the right person by location, product or round-robin rules.
Reminds staff about follow-ups and escalates leads that go untouched.
Tracks deals through stages such as New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal, Won and Lost.
Logs calls, emails, chats, notes, quotes and documents against each customer.
Manages service requests, warranties, installations and field visits.
Sends automated emails, SMS and WhatsApp messages with consent.
Shows dashboards for pipeline value, conversion rates and team performance.

main_content.text: CRM Software Examples

Many businesses ask for CRM software examples before deciding what to use. The list below shows well-known products and the kind of business each is generally used for. It is for orientation only: we are not affiliated with these vendors, features change often, and the right choice depends on your process, budget and integrations.

rows: Broad, highly customisable platform for sales, service and marketing
Mid-sized and large companies with complex processes
Marketing-led platform with sales and service tools; offers a free starter tier
Small and mid-sized businesses doing inbound marketing
Part of the Zoho suite of business apps; popular with Indian SMBs
Small and mid-sized B2B and service businesses
Sales-focused product within the Freshworks suite
Growing sales teams, e-commerce, hospitality, real estate
Sales execution and lead management with strong automation
High-volume lead businesses such as education, healthcare and lending
Sales and service modules connected to Microsoft 365
Small sales teams that want ease of use
Service management platform (complaints, warranties, AMC, field service)

main_content.text: Looking for Servitium CRM or Butterfly CRM?
People often search for specific product names, and two that appear often in India are Servitium CRM and Butterfly CRM. We want to be clear so you reach the right place.

Servitium CRM is a service management platform from Path Infotech Limited. According to its website, it covers omnichannel complaint registration, warranty and AMC management, install-base management, workshop repair and field service, with separate apps for customers, field engineers, supervisors and retailers, and it lists consumer brands such as Butterfly, Crompton and Panasonic among its clients. Afwan Tech is not connected with Servitium, Path Infotech or any of those brands.

Searches for "Butterfly CRM" usually come from people trying to reach a brand's service or complaint portal, or from people looking for a product with a similar name. If you need help with a Butterfly appliance, please use the official Butterfly website or customer care channels. If you are a business looking for a service CRM like the one these brands use, we can help you compare ready-made service platforms or build one around your own process.
Is There a Best CRM Software in India?

There is no single best CRM software in India for every business. Rankings in articles and review sites differ because each one weighs price, features, ease of use and support differently, and some rankings are sponsored. The best choice for you is the one your team will actually use every day, that connects to your channels, and that you can afford to run and maintain for years.
How to Judge Options Fairly

rows: Does it match how you sell or serve today, or will you have to change everything?
Can a new salesperson learn it in a day? Is the mobile app good?
Does it connect to WhatsApp, your phone system, website forms, ad platforms and accounting?
Does it support INR, GST invoices, Indian phone formats, regional languages and local payment links?
Can you export all your data at any time in a usable format?
Are there role-based permissions, audit logs and two-factor login?
What do users, add-ons, storage, integrations and support cost over three years?
Is help available in your time zone and language?

main_content.text: When we help clients choose, we score two or three shortlisted options against these criteria using their real data and a short trial, rather than relying on top-ten lists.
Ready-Made CRM Tools vs Custom CRM Software
There are three realistic routes. The table compares them honestly so you can see where each one makes sense.

rows: Per-user subscriptions that grow with your team
Hosting and maintenance; no per-user licences
Vendor owns the platform; you own your data
You own the code and data
Small teams with standard sales steps
Growing businesses with some unique steps
Unique workflows, large user counts, strict data or industry needs

main_content.text: For many small businesses, a well-configured ready-made product is the right answer. Custom CRM development makes sense when your process is a genuine competitive advantage, when per-user licence costs become heavy as the team grows, or when you need deep links with systems no product supports.
Our CRM Software Services
Custom CRM Development

We design and build a platform around your exact process: lead sources, stages, approval steps, quotes, service tickets, dealer or franchise structures and reports. It is built as a secure web application with a mobile app if your team works in the field. You own the source code, the database and the hosting account. If you have been searching for a CRM development company, this is the service that covers a fully bespoke build.
Setup and Customisation of Ready-Made Platforms

If a ready-made product fits, we configure it properly: pipelines, fields, user roles, automation rules, templates, dashboards and permissions. We import your existing data, connect your channels and train your team, so the tool is used from day one instead of being abandoned after a month.
Integration Services

Most value comes from connecting the customer database to everything else. We build and maintain links with your website, landing pages, Google and Meta lead forms, WhatsApp Business Platform, cloud telephony and IVR, email, accounting software, payment gateways, e-commerce stores and ERP systems.
Data Migration and Clean-Up
We move records from spreadsheets, old software or several tools into one system, removing duplicates, fixing phone formats and mapping fields, so your team starts with clean, trusted data.
Mobile Apps for Field Teams
Sales executives, service engineers and delivery staff can log visits, capture photos and signatures, update tickets and see customer history on Android or iPhone, even with patchy connectivity.
Support, Training and Improvements
After launch we provide user training, admin guides, bug fixes, security updates and planned improvements. Many clients add features in small phases once they see how the team uses the system.
Features We Build Into a CRM System

rows: Lead capture from every source, auto-assignment, follow-up reminders, deal stages, quotations, product catalogues, targets and leaderboards
Source and campaign tracking, segments, email and WhatsApp campaigns with consent, landing page forms, return-on-spend reports
Ticketing, SLA timers, escalation rules, warranty and AMC tracking, knowledge base, customer feedback
Visit scheduling, GPS check-in, job cards, photo and signature capture, spare-parts usage
Live dashboards, conversion funnels, revenue forecasts, team activity, export to spreadsheets
Role-based access, audit logs, data export, backup, two-factor login, multi-branch and multi-language support

main_content.text: We build only what you need. A focused first version that the team actually uses is worth more than a large system nobody opens.
CRM Software for Different Industries
Every industry has its own workflow. These are common patterns we plan for.

rows: Lead capture from property portals and ads, site-visit scheduling, inventory of units, broker management, payment milestones
Enquiry capture, counselling calls, demo-class booking, admissions pipeline, fee reminders, parent communication
Appointment enquiries, follow-up reminders, treatment packages, patient feedback, strict data access controls
Dealer and distributor management, quotations, order tracking, territory sales, service requests
Complaint registration, warranty and AMC, technician dispatch, spare parts, customer feedback
Itinerary quotes, booking stages, supplier coordination, repeat-customer campaigns
Account management, long sales cycles, proposals, renewals and contract tracking

main_content.text: Integrations Indian Businesses Need Most
A customer database is only useful when information flows into it automatically. These are the integrations we are asked for most often.

items: WhatsApp Business Platform: incoming enquiries create or update records; approved templates send reminders and updates with opt-in.
Cloud telephony and IVR: missed calls create leads, call recordings and durations attach to the customer, click-to-call from the record.
Website and landing page forms: every form submission arrives with its source, page and campaign tags.
Google Ads and Meta lead forms: leads sync within minutes so the team can call while interest is high.
Accounting and invoicing: customer and invoice data shared with tools such as Tally or Zoho Books, avoiding double entry.
Payment links and gateways: payment status updates on the deal or order automatically.
Email and calendar: meetings and emails logged against the right contact.
E-commerce stores: orders, customers and abandoned carts flow into the system for follow-up.

main_content.text: Follow-up calls and SMS must respect TRAI's commercial communication rules, which keep promotional calls on the 140 number series and require consent and opt-out handling. We build consent records and do-not-call flags into the system for that reason.
How We Build Integrations That Last

A CRM integration that breaks silently is worse than none, because the team stops trusting the data. We use official APIs wherever they exist, log every sync, send alerts when a connection fails, retry automatically and document each link so another developer can maintain it. Duplicate checks run on phone number and email before a new record is created, so the same enquiry arriving by form and WhatsApp does not appear twice.
How a CRM Project Works
Every CRM project we run follows the same stages, whether we configure a ready-made product or build custom CRM software. The order protects you from paying for features nobody uses.

items: Discovery. We map how leads, customers and service requests move through your business today, who touches them and where they get lost.
Recommendation. We compare ready-made, customised and custom options for your case and explain the trade-offs in writing.
Scope and plan. You receive the features, integrations, data to migrate, user roles, reports, timeline stages and the exact total for the agreed scope.
Design. We prototype the main screens and workflows and test them with a few real users before building.
Build or configure. Development or configuration happens in short cycles, with a demo at the end of each so you can give feedback early.
Data migration. Records are cleaned, de-duplicated and imported, and a sample is checked with your team.
Testing. We test every workflow, integration, permission and report with realistic data.
Training and launch. Admins and users are trained; we launch in phases, often one team or branch first.
Support and improvement. We fix issues quickly, monitor usage and plan the next set of improvements with you.

main_content.text: Indicative Timeline by Stage
Note: these stages are indicative only. Real timelines depend on scope, number of integrations, data quality and how quickly feedback and approvals arrive. We confirm a schedule in the written plan.

header: What decides how long it takes
rows: Number of teams, branches and products involved
How many user roles and screens are needed
Development or setup in short cycles
Custom build vs ready-made, number of features
How many systems, and whether they have usable APIs
Volume and quality of existing data
Team size, locations and language needs

main_content.text: What the Cost of a CRM Software Project Depends On
We do not publish fixed prices, because two businesses asking for CRM software rarely need the same thing. The total depends on:

items: The route: configuring a ready-made product, customising it heavily, or building a custom platform.
Number of users, teams, branches and user roles.
Features and workflows, especially service, field and approval processes.
Number and complexity of integrations.
Volume and condition of the data to migrate.
Mobile apps, offline use and regional language support.
Third-party costs such as product subscriptions, cloud hosting, telephony and WhatsApp messaging charges, paid directly to those providers.
Training, support and future improvements.

main_content.text: Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements, in writing, before any work starts.
Data Security, Privacy and Compliance
Your customer database holds some of the most sensitive information in your business. We design every system with protection in mind.

items: Role-based access, so each person sees only the records and fields they need.
Audit logs of who viewed, changed, exported or deleted data.
Two-factor login, strong password rules and automatic session timeouts.
Encrypted connections and regular, tested backups.
Consent records for marketing messages and easy opt-out handling.
Data export and deletion tools to respond to customer requests.

main_content.text: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 apply in phases to personal data you collect and process. We build consent, access and deletion features, but your legal adviser should confirm what your business must do. This is general information, not legal advice.
Signs Your Business Needs CRM Software

items: Enquiries arrive through several channels and nobody sees them all in one place.
Leads are called late, twice or not at all.
Customer history leaves the company when a salesperson leaves.
Managers cannot say which source brings paying customers.
Service complaints are tracked in notebooks or chat groups, and promised times are missed.
Quotes, follow-ups and renewals depend on individual memory.

main_content.text: If three or more of these sound familiar, a properly set-up system will usually pay for itself in recovered leads and saved time, whether it is a ready-made product or custom CRM software.
Getting Your Team to Use It

Adoption decides success more than features do. We keep the first version simple, set up screens around each role, import clean data so people trust what they see, and train users with their own real records. We also agree a few habits, such as updating the stage after every call, and set up dashboards so managers can coach rather than chase. A named internal owner, usually a sales or operations manager, collects feedback each week and decides which small changes to request next, which keeps the system aligned with how the business actually works as it grows. Usage reports in the first months show who needs help, and small improvements based on feedback keep the system useful.
Measuring the Results of Your CRM System

rows: How quickly new leads are contacted
Which channels bring buyers, not just enquiries
Where coaching or redistribution is needed
Ticket resolution time and SLA breaches
Whether the team is really using the system

main_content.text: We set a baseline before launch and review these numbers with you after one and three months.
AI Features in Modern CRM Tools

Many products now include AI features such as lead scoring, call summaries, suggested replies and sales forecasts. They can save time, but they rely on clean, complete data and still need human review, especially for messages sent to customers. We help you switch on the features that fit, and we never send customer data to unapproved third-party tools.
A Short Glossary

rows: A person or company that has shown interest but is not yet a customer
Capturing, assigning, following up and qualifying enquiries until they convert or close
The stages a deal moves through, from first contact to won or lost
A qualified sales possibility with an expected value
A recorded service request or complaint
The promised time to respond to or resolve a ticket
Rules that assign, remind, escalate or message automatically
A standard way for two software systems to exchange data

main_content.text: Cloud, Private Cloud or On-Premise?

rows: Most small and mid-sized businesses using ready-made products
Fast to start; data hosted by the vendor; check export and data-location terms
Custom builds where you want control without running servers in the office
You own the account; hosting and maintenance costs are paid by you
Organisations with strict internal IT policies
Highest control; needs in-house IT for updates, security and backups

main_content.text: For custom CRM software we usually recommend hosting in a cloud account registered in your company's name, with automated backups, monitoring and a documented recovery plan, so the system keeps running even if you change development partners.
Three Typical Situations
The situations below are illustrative, based on common requests. Names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Real Estate Developer Losing Portal Leads

A developer (details changed) receives enquiries from property portals, Meta ads and walk-ins, tracked in spreadsheets. Many leads are called a day late. A configured ready-made product with automatic lead capture, instant assignment, WhatsApp follow-ups and site-visit scheduling solves most of the problem without custom code.
Situation 2: An Appliance Brand Managing Service Complaints

A regional appliance brand (details changed) handles complaints by phone and email, with no view of technician workload or warranty status. A service-focused platform with complaint registration, warranty checks, technician dispatch through a mobile app and customer feedback brings order to the process. Because its dealer and spare-parts process is unusual, a custom build is compared against ready-made service products before deciding.
Situation 3: An EdTech Start-Up Outgrowing Its Tool

A growing coaching institute (details changed) pays for many user licences on a product it only half uses, and its counselling process needs custom steps. A custom platform with counselling stages, demo-class booking, fee reminders and telephony integration is built in phases, with data migrated from the old tool.
Common Mistakes in CRM Projects

items: Buying a product before mapping your own process.
Trying to build every feature in the first version.
Importing messy, duplicated data without cleaning it.
Skipping integrations, so staff still copy leads by hand.
No training or internal owner, so adoption fades after a few weeks.
Giving everyone access to everything, which creates privacy and security risks.
Choosing a vendor that makes data export difficult.
Measuring success by features launched rather than follow-up speed, conversion and customer satisfaction.

main_content.text: What We Do Not Do

items: We do not sell or resell licences, and we do not claim official partnership with any CRM brand unless a verified badge is shown.
We do not provide access to, or support for, other companies' customer portals, including Servitium or brand service portals.
We do not buy, sell or scrape contact lists.
We do not set up spam calling or messaging without consent.
We do not keep your code or data hostage; everything is handed over.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need a Custom CRM

If you have a small team, a simple sales process and standard channels, a ready-made product used well is usually enough, and some vendors offer free starter tiers. If your team is not yet following up leads consistently, start with a simple shared pipeline and clear habits before investing in software. We will tell you if a custom build is not justified.
Questions to Ask Before Choosing a CRM Partner

items: Will you recommend a ready-made product if it fits, or only custom work?
Who owns the code, database, hosting and product accounts?
How will our existing data be cleaned and migrated?
Which integrations are included, and how will they be maintained?
How will you train our team and measure adoption?
What happens if we want to switch providers later?
How do you handle security, access control and personal data?

Experience with the channels Indian businesses rely on: WhatsApp, calls, ad lead forms and payment links.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About CRM Software
What is CRM software?

CRM software is a customer relationship management system that stores leads, customers, interactions, deals and service requests in one place. It helps teams follow up on time and gives managers clear reports.
What are some CRM software examples?

Well-known examples include Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Freshsales, LeadSquared, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive and Kylas, plus service platforms such as Servitium CRM. Each suits different business sizes and processes.
Which is the best CRM software in India?
There is no single best option for every business. The right choice fits your process, connects to your channels, is easy for your team and is affordable to run over several years.
What is the difference between CRM tools and a CRM system?
The terms are often used interchangeably. CRM tools usually means individual products or features, while a CRM system often refers to the complete setup, including integrations, data and workflows.
Do you build custom CRM software?
Yes. We design and build custom platforms around your process, with web and mobile access, and you own the code and data.
Can you customise Zoho, HubSpot or Salesforce?
Yes, we can configure and integrate ready-made products. We are not an official partner or reseller of these brands unless a verified badge is shown.
What is Servitium CRM?
Servitium CRM is a service management platform from Path Infotech Limited covering complaints, warranties, AMC and field service. Afwan Tech is not connected with it.
What is Butterfly CRM?

Searches for Butterfly CRM usually relate to a brand's service portal or a similarly named product. For appliance service, use the brand's official channels; for a business service CRM, we can help you choose or build one.
How long does a CRM project take?
It depends on the route, features, integrations and data. Configuring a ready-made product is fastest, while custom builds are delivered in phases; we confirm a schedule after discovery.
How much does CRM software cost?
The total depends on the route, users, features, integrations, data migration and third-party subscriptions. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.
Can the CRM connect to WhatsApp?
Yes. Through the WhatsApp Business Platform, incoming messages can create or update records and approved templates can send updates to customers who have opted in.
Can you move our data from Excel or another CRM?
Yes. We clean, de-duplicate and map your data, then import it and check a sample with your team before launch.
Will we own our data and code?
Yes. Your data always belongs to you, and for custom builds you also own the source code, database and hosting accounts.
Is our customer data safe?
We use role-based access, audit logs, two-factor login, encryption and tested backups, and design consent and deletion features with India's DPDP Act in mind.
Do you provide a mobile CRM app?
Yes. We build Android and iPhone apps for field sales and service teams, including visit logging, photos, signatures and offline use where needed.
How do I start?
Call or WhatsApp 79798 50684, or email contactafwantech@gmail.com, to book a free consultation. We will map your process and recommend the simplest suitable option.

What "Quality Backlinks" Means in Our Plans

We earn links from relevant directories, local listings, industry sites, partners and genuine mentions. We do not buy links from link farms or private blog networks, because those can harm a website. The monthly number in each plan is our working target; we report every link we build so you can check it yourself.
Why We Recommend at Least Three Months

Search engines take time to crawl changes, and new content needs time to earn trust. For that reason we recommend a minimum of three months on any plan. Many businesses start to see movement in rankings and enquiries within three to six months, but results depend on your competition, your website's history and how quickly changes go live, so we never promise a fixed outcome or the first position.
Affordable SEO Services: What Makes a Plan Good Value

Affordable SEO services are not simply the cheapest ones. A low monthly fee that delivers no real work, or that relies on spammy links, costs more in the long run. Good value means you know exactly what is done every month, the work suits your size, and the reports show real progress. Our affordable local SEO services are priced so a single-city clinic or shop pays only for the reach it needs, while a growing business can move up a plan without starting over.
When you compare affordable search engine optimization offers, check these points:

items: Is the monthly price published or at least written down, with deliverables listed?
Are the number of keywords, pages, blogs and listings clear?
Who owns the website, content, Google Business Profile and analytics accounts?
How are backlinks built, and will you see a list?
Is there a lock-in period, and what happens if you stop?
Are reports in plain language, with enquiries and calls tracked, not just rankings?
Does anyone promise "guaranteed first page" results? That is a warning sign.

main_content.text: Affordable SEO Service for Small Business Owners

An affordable SEO service for small business owners should focus on the searches that bring paying customers nearby, not vanity keywords. For most small businesses this means a well-managed Google Business Profile, accurate listings, reviews, a fast mobile website and pages that answer local questions. That is exactly what our Local plan covers. If you serve only one area, you do not need a nationwide plan; if you later open a second branch or start selling across India, you can upgrade.
Affordable Local SEO Services vs DIY SEO

Some owners handle basic SEO themselves, and that can work for very small websites. You can claim your Google Business Profile, ask customers for reviews and keep your contact details consistent for free. Affordable local SEO services make sense when you do not have the time to research keywords, write content every month, fix technical issues and build listings consistently. Whatever you choose, keep ownership of every account in your business name.
Which SEO Plan Is Right for You?
Choosing a plan is easier when you start from where your customers are, not from the number of keywords. Use these examples as a guide; we confirm the right fit during the free website check.

main_content.text: If you are unsure, start smaller. Moving up a plan later is simple, and the work already done carries forward.
How We Keep City Pages Useful

Plans that include city and service pages can help you appear for searches in many places, but only if each page is genuinely useful. Pages that only swap the city name can be treated as low-quality by search engines. We write every location page with real details, such as the areas you serve, delivery or visit times, local projects you are allowed to show and answers to local questions. If you do not serve a place, we do not create a page for it.
What Affordable Local SEO Services Include Every Month

Whichever plan you choose, our affordable local SEO services follow the same monthly rhythm. In the first week we review rankings, enquiries and any technical issues. Through the month we publish the planned blog articles, update pages, add listings and build links. We also post updates on your Google Business Profile and reply to reviews if you want us to. At the end of the month you receive a report that explains, in plain words, what was done, what changed and what we will focus on next.

Website development charges depend on what the website needs to do. A five-page brochure site for a consultant is very different from a portal with logins, bookings and payments. That is why we publish a starting price for WordPress websites and quote custom-coded websites only after understanding your requirements.

main_content.text: Website Creation Charges in India: Beyond the Build

Website creation charges in India often look different between providers because some include items that others leave out. Before you compare quotes, check whether each one includes the domain, hosting, SSL certificate, business email, premium themes or plugins, content writing, stock images, maintenance and SEO setup. A lower quote that excludes these can end up costing more than a complete one.
Website Design India Price: Design Choices That Matter

The website design India price you are quoted depends mostly on how custom the design is. A customised theme is quick and affordable. A fully custom design involves research, wireframes, a visual design for desktop and mobile, and revisions before development starts. For brands that rely on their website to win trust, custom UI/UX design is often worth it; for a new small business, a clean customised theme is usually enough to start.

An online store needs more than pages: it needs a product catalogue, cart, checkout, payment gateway, shipping, taxes, order management and customer accounts. That is why the ecommerce website cost is always higher than a simple business website, and why we quote every store after understanding your products and sales process.

main_content.text: Ecommerce Website Development Cost in India: Running Costs to Plan

The ecommerce website development cost in India also includes costs you pay to other companies. Payment gateways usually charge a fee per transaction; hosted platforms such as Shopify charge a subscription and may charge app fees; courier partners charge per shipment; and premium plugins or apps have renewals. We list these in your quote so you know the true cost of running the store.
Cost of E-Commerce Website Development in India: Three Common Routes
The cost of e-commerce website development in India depends a lot on the route you choose:

items: WooCommerce on WordPress: flexible, you own the website, good for small and mid-sized catalogues; needs good hosting and maintenance.
Shopify: quick to launch with hosting included; you pay a monthly subscription and some app fees.
Custom e-commerce: built for special workflows such as B2B pricing, multi-vendor marketplaces or complex inventory; highest flexibility and highest build cost.

main_content.text: E-Commerce Website Making Cost in India: Tips to Control the Budget

To keep the e-commerce website making cost in India under control, launch with the features you need now, start with your best-selling products, use proven payment and shipping integrations, and add features such as loyalty points or marketplaces later. A phased plan keeps the first bill smaller and lets real sales guide what you build next.

The ecommerce mobile app development cost is often higher than a store website because you need app store publishing, push notifications and support for many devices.
